items.title: Cineasta da Caxemira Arfat Sheikh é libertado da detenção pelo ICE nos EUA, segundo campanha
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: O premiado cineasta da Caxemira Arfat Sheikh foi libertado sob fiança na quinta-feira da detenção do Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA (ICE), após ter sido detido em 24 de setembro, de acordo com um comunicado divulgado por uma campanha organizada por seus amigos e familiares para libertá-lo.
items.body:
O premiado cineasta da Caxemira Arfat Sheikh foi libertado sob fiança na quinta-feira da detenção do Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega dos EUA (ICE), após ter sido detido em 24 de setembro, de acordo com um comunicado divulgado por uma campanha organizada por seus amigos e familiares para libertá-lo.
Sheikh, cujo trabalho tem explorado o conflito na Caxemira administrada pela Índia, sua terra natal, foi detido pelo ICE, órgão do Departamento de Segurança Interna (DHS), ao desembarcar de um voo vindo da Califórnia no Aeroporto Internacional de Washington Dulles, informou a campanha.
A campanha informou que a fiança de Sheikh foi concedida na terça-feira e ele foi liberado na quinta-feira, acrescentando que o processo de deportação contra ele continua.
De acordo com a campanha, Sheikh, que morava em Alexandria, Virgínia, entrou nos EUA em 2019 com um visto de estudante para cursar pós-graduação em cinema na Georgia State University e solicitou asilo em 2020. A campanha afirmou que ele tinha um pedido de imigração pendente e estava autorizado a trabalhar e morar nos EUA.
O Departamento de Segurança Interna disse na quarta-feira que Sheikh foi preso em 24 de setembro. Segundo o órgão, Sheikh “entrou legalmente nos EUA de forma temporária e permaneceu no país ilegalmente após o término de sua admissão legal”. Um pedido pendente não confere status legal nos EUA, afirmou o DHS, acrescentando que ele terá direito ao devido processo legal.
O governo do presidente Donald Trump disse em agosto que estava trabalhando “para identificar e revogar os vistos de não imigrante de estrangeiros que vieram aos EUA alegando ser visitantes de curta duração, mas que depois solicitam asilo para permanecer aqui permanentemente”.
Trump tem promovido uma repressão à imigração e uma campanha de deportação que, segundo ele, visa melhorar a segurança interna. Defensores dos direitos humanos afirmam que a repressão tem violado o devido processo legal e os direitos à liberdade de expressão, além de ter criado um ambiente inseguro, especialmente para as minorias étnicas, que têm manifestado preocupações com o perfilamento racial.

items.title: Primera victoria de Red Bull con su motor de F1, un triunfo de la convicción para su artífice
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: El responsable de sistemas de propulsión de Red Bull, Ben Hodgkinson, prefiere hablar de confianza más que de expectativas tras la histórica primera victoria de la escudería como fabricante de motores de Fórmula Uno.
items.body:
El responsable de sistemas de propulsión de Red Bull, Ben Hodgkinson, prefiere hablar de confianza más que de expectativas tras la histórica primera victoria de la escudería como fabricante de motores de Fórmula Uno.
La victoria de Max Verstappen, partiendo desde la pole position y con vuelta rápida incluida, en el Gran Premio de Baréin del pasado fin de semana en Malasia se produjo en la decimosexta carrera de la era de las nuevas normas de la F1.
La hazaña superó las expectativas de quienes dudaban de que la marca de bebidas energéticas pudiera igualar a potencias consolidadas como Mercedes y Ferrari al construir desde cero una de las unidades de potencia más complejas de la historia de este deporte.
Sepang también supuso la primera pole de 2026 conseguida por un monoplaza que no montaba un motor Mercedes, pero Hodgkinson se mostró cauto ante un exceso de optimismo cuando se le preguntó por las expectativas.
"Hemos ganado una carrera. Una de dieciséis", afirmó a Reuters antes del Gran Premio de Singapur de este fin de semana y de la 250ª partida del tetracampeón Verstappen.
"Creo que 'expectativa' es una palabra peligrosa para cualquier ingeniero de Fórmula Uno. En cuanto empiezas a subestimar a la competencia, es cuando empiezas a perder. Todo el proyecto (del motor) se construyó con la convicción de que esto era posible. Así que lo creí. No lo esperaba", comentó.
"AUDAZ Y ATREVIDO" El camino desde el centro de ingeniería hasta la realidad del circuito no ha sido fácil para Red Bull, que dominó en épocas anteriores con motores suministrados por otros.
"Ha habido muchos momentos a lo largo del camino en los que parecía que las cosas no iban muy bien. Y conseguir finalmente ponerlo todo en marcha para lograr esa victoria fue, sin duda, un momento muy especial", afirmó Hodgkinson desde su despacho en la fábrica de Milton Keynes.
"Mucha gente no creía que fuéramos a estar en esta posición. Otros equipos, miembros de la prensa, probablemente incluso miembros de nuestra propia familia, pensaban que nos estábamos embarcando en algo bastante extremo", agregó.
"Pero la mentalidad colectiva y algo que me ha parecido realmente único en Red Bull es la voluntad de emprender proyectos audaces y atrevidos y demostrar que todo el mundo se equivocaba", indicó.
Red Bull tuvo que empezar de cero, contratando a expertos de otros equipos, mientras que sus rivales podían centrarse exclusivamente en fabricar un sistema de propulsión a partir de las instalaciones ya existentes. Los recién llegados Audi y los que regresan Honda aún están muy lejos de contar con un paquete ganador.
Mercedes ha ganado 11 de las 16 carreras, Ferrari y McLaren dos cada uno, y tan solo el mes pasado el exjefe del equipo Haas, Guenther Steiner, afirmaba que no veía a Red Bull ganando este año. Hodgkinson, que llegó procedente de Mercedes, afirmó que esas dudas fueron "leña para nuestro fuego".
"Hay algo en este proyecto que es muy propio de Red Bull", dijo. "Ya sabes, la 'simple empresa de refrescos' que se atreve a fabricar tanto el grupo motopropulsor como el chasis".
"Es algo que, en mi opinión, probablemente solo alguien como Red Bull se atrevería a hacer. Y se llevó a cabo con la ambición de querer lograr algo grandioso desde el primer momento", afirmó.
PUNTO DE REFERENCIA Red Bull es la única escudería con sede en Reino Unido que cuenta con la producción de la unidad de potencia y el chasis en las mismas instalaciones, mientras que Mercedes tiene sus operaciones repartidas entre Brackley y Brixworth.
Ford es socio de Red Bull y Hodgkinson afirmó que la ayuda del gigante automovilístico estadounidense en materia de personal, instalaciones y fabricación fue inestimable.
Aunque lo de Sepang fue una sorpresa, posiblemente favorecida por el firme del circuito y, sin duda, por el hecho de que Verstappen alcanzara otro nivel, el motor ya había marcado la pauta, hasta el punto de que la FIA, como organismo regulador, lo declaró el punto de referencia con el que se debe evaluar a los demás.
Las unidades de potencia de 2026 se reparten en una proporción de 53-47 entre combustión y electricidad, y el equilibrio se inclinará más hacia la primera en los próximos años.
"Creo que obsesionarse demasiado con el mejor motor es algo a lo que el reglamento casi te obliga (…) pero en realidad lo que importa es tu ritmo general", afirmó Hodgkinson cuando se le preguntó si el suyo era realmente el mejor.
"A veces puedes tomar decisiones sobre los motores que, en realidad, reducirían su rendimiento, pero que, en conjunto, hacen que el auto vaya más rápido. Por eso nos medimos por nuestro rendimiento en pista", señaló.
"Estoy muy orgulloso de lo que hemos conseguido", añadió, levantando de su escritorio una taza con el eslogan "Red Bull, mejor con hielo", un doble sentido que podría referirse tanto al motor de combustión interna como a la bebida. "Eso es todo. Tengo una taza que lo demuestra".
items.raw_description: El responsable de sistemas de propulsión de Red Bull, Ben Hodgkinson, prefiere hablar de confianza más que de expectativas tras la histórica primera victoria de la escudería como fabricante de motores de Fórmula Uno.

items.title: India central bank to sell $2.6 bln of bonds, tighten bank reserve need to squeeze cash
items.author: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
items.summary: India's central bank announced the next leg of open market bond sales and tightened daily maintenance of cash reserve ratio on Friday in a bid to further drain rupee liquidity from the banking system.
items.body:
India's central bank announced the next leg of open market bond sales and tightened daily maintenance of cash reserve ratio on Friday in a bid to further drain rupee liquidity from the banking system.
The Reserve Bank of India will sell 250 billion rupees ($2.58 billion) of bonds on Tuesday through open market operations, an effective liquidity-draining tool. The regulator also mandated that banks would need to maintain 99% of the daily CRR from October 16 against 90% earlier.
The moves come days after the RBI raised its key policy rate for the first time in nearly four years and signalled more rate hikes.
The central bank did not announce any liquidity draining measures in the policy. RBI Governor [USN:L4N45T0GV TEXT:"Sanjay Malhotra"] said the surge in liquidity would not be a long-term phenomenon and a large amount of liquidity would get absorbed within this financial year the ends in March.
Last month, the RBI [USN:L4N45K0OD TEXT:"sold bonds"] worth 1 trillion rupees, the highest net sale in over a decade.
Markets should be prepared for the liquidity surplus to fall below 1% of deposits and potentially lie in the 0%-0.5% of deposits range in the coming quarters, ICICI Securities Primary Dealership said in a note.
"OMO sales have led to bear flattening of the yield curve," the primary dealer said.
India's banking system liquidity surplus has averaged more than 7 trillion rupees ($72.37 billion) on a daily basis from September 1, amounting to 2.6% of deposits.
The RBI will sell bonds maturing from fiscal 2030 to fiscal 2035, including 7.88% 2030, 6.10% 2031, 7.95% 2032, 7.26% 2033, 7.18% 2033 and 7.10% 2034 notes.
Banks park 3% of their deposits with the RBI under CRR, and do not earn any income on these funds.
($1 = 96.7300 Indian rupees)

Isaías se intensificó hasta convertirse en un huracán de categoría 3 y se espera que gire hacia el norte a lo largo del día, según el último boletín emitido el viernes por el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos.
El huracán está a unas 170 millas (275 kilómetros) al sureste de la desembocadura del río Misisipi, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 120 mph (195 km/h), añadió el CNH.

items.title: What is the low-band spectrum that SpaceX acquired for Starlink Mobile
items.author: Harshita Varghese
items.creator: Harshita Varghese
items.summary: SpaceX has agreed to acquire a nationwide portfolio of licenses in the low-band spectrum in a deal reportedly valued at $8 billion, as it looks to expand beyond satellite internet and become a serious competitor in the US mobile market.
items.body:
SpaceX (SPCX.O) has [USN:L6N45U1AK TEXT:"agreed"] to acquire a nationwide portfolio of licenses in the low-band spectrum in a deal reportedly valued at $8 billion, as it looks to expand beyond satellite internet and become a serious competitor in the US mobile market.
The company first disclosed its plans to enter the mobile services sector during its inaugural earnings call in August. The announcement [USN:L1N4420CG TEXT:"briefly weighed"] on shares of the three major US wireless carriers - AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon - as investors assessed the potential competitive threat.
WHAT IS LOW-BAND SPECTRUM? Low-band spectrum refers to airwaves that can travel farther and penetrate buildings better than higher frequencies, making them useful for broad-area mobile coverage.
This differs from mid- and high-band spectrum, which can carry more data at a faster speed but cover less area.
SpaceX has agreed to acquire up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz low-band spectrum licenses from Grain Management, with plans to develop a hybrid architecture for Starlink Mobile that combines terrestrial infrastructure with satellite connectivity.
HOW DOES THE US SPECTRUM LICENSING SYSTEM WORK? Commercial spectrum is a scarce resource in the US, regulated by the Federal Communications Commission, which typically assigns licenses for specific frequencies and geographic areas through auctions or other authorized processes.
License holders must comply with technical rules and deployment requirements, but before that comes the transfer of licenses, which generally requires regulatory approval.
The latest SpaceX deal for spectrum licenses is awaiting FCC approval.
WHAT SPECTRUM DO THE THREE MAJOR CARRIERS HOLD? AT&T's low-band portfolio includes 700 MHz and 850 MHz spectrum, as well as 600 MHz licenses acquired through its July EchoStar deal.
Verizon holds spectrum in the 700 MHz and 850 MHz bands, while T-Mobile's low-band holdings include 600 MHz and 700 MHz spectrum.
WHAT IS THE PLAN FOR STARLINK MOBILE? The company plans to integrate the spectrum into its next-generation satellite system, while also deploying ground-based radios and antennas on towers and rooftops.
The FCC approved Starlink Mobile's Gen2 constellation application this week, authorizing SpaceX to launch 15,000 satellites optimized for 2 GHz spectrum worldwide.

items.title: Germany wants a seat in ECB's governing bodies, finmin says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Germany wants to continue to be "strongly represented" in the European Central Bank's governing bodies in the future, German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Friday in Luxembourg on the sidelines of a finance ministers meeting.
items.body:
Germany wants to continue to be "strongly represented" in the European Central Bank's governing bodies in the future, German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Friday in Luxembourg on the sidelines of a finance ministers meeting.
"I am coordinating closely with the Federal Chancellery on all issues concerning the ECB, and of course, we will put forward a German candidate," Klingbeil said.
Euro zone finance ministers on Thursday started a process to replace European Central Bank board [USN:L8N45U1U5 TEXT:"member Isabel Schnabel"], who will leave the ECB on January 3 to take up a post at the International Monetary Fund.
"In the bilateral discussions here, I have noticed that every colleague is very clear that Germany plays a role at the ECB," Klingbeil added.

items.title: In parched Hungary, volunteers build their own dams to hold onto vanishing water
items.author: Marton Monus, Krisztina Than
items.creator: Marton Monus, Krisztina Than
items.summary: In a bone-dry valley in Hungary, forest workers and volunteers piled up terraces of logs and deadwood, hoping to catch any trickles of water that make it down the hillside when the rains finally come.
items.body:
In a bone-dry valley in Hungary, forest workers and volunteers piled up terraces of logs and deadwood, hoping to catch any trickles of water that make it down the hillside when the rains finally come.
In other areas, other groups fanned out, building barriers across streams and small creeks — their own man-made "beaver dams" designed to pool water and prepare the landscape for an even hotter, drier future.
As of this week, they were still waiting for that rain after a drought-hit summer that brought river levels to [USN:L8N4490NK TEXT:"record lows"], disrupting everything from cargo barges to the country's Paks [USN:L8N4490NK TEXT:"nuclear plant"], which relies on flows of cooling water from the Danube.
But the teams working under the banner of the grassroots, volunteer "Water Guardians Movement" kept on building, getting ready.
'WE CAN IMPROVE THE SITUATION' "The wells (on my farm) have practically run dry," said Bence Bardos, a forest engineer leading the team building terraces in the Ladany valley in eastern Hungary near the border with Slovakia.
"This is the impact from climate change and our special geography in the Carpathian basin."
There was little locals could do about that, he said. "But we can improve the situation by small steps, by reversing the water runoff and drainage," the 36-year-old added.
The volunteers are turning out in their hundreds to help the country build structures to retain rainwater and restore wetlands — techniques that mark a sharp turnaround from the past, when programmes focused on managing floods, not droughts.
Nearly a quarter of the country lies on floodplains, and experts spent decades draining wetlands and building canals to channel water away from the fields and open up more land for agriculture.
"We have regulated our rivers, cutting their bends, which means the rivers flow faster, which drains ground water nearby," Diana Ürge-Vorsatz, a professor at the Central European University in Vienna, said.
Much of that now needed to go into reverse. The important thing now was to "restore the original natural conditions as much as possible, to allow rivers to flow on longer routes and thus slower, and retain ground water in the winter-spring," Ürge-Vorsatz added.
The government announced a new strategy in August which prioritised "natural water retention methods" and, far from draining fields, said some farmland should be deliberately flooded.
RESEARCHERS 'CAN'T PERFORM A RAIN DANCE' Agriculture, one of the planks of Hungary's economy, has borne the brunt of the drier conditions.
Many farmers have [USN:L8N44T097 TEXT:"given up on maize"] and shifted to alternatives, as researchers work on drought-resistant varieties.
This was the first year when the harvested area of maize in Hungary fell below the area planted with sunflowers, said Zoltan Kende, associate professor at the Institute of Agronomy at the MATE University.
But even sunflowers have suffered from the drought.
"We have shown that dry weather alters the fatty acid composition of sunflowers, resulting in a change in oil quality," Kende added.
Researchers could not "perform a rain dance" but there were recommendations they could make on cultivation and other methods to help adaptation, he said.
"For each cultivated plant species, we investigate the optimal factors as for temperature, moisture ... that result in the fastest germination. This approach helps enhance resilience against drought damage."
Hungary's central bank has said the drought damage to agriculture would cut economic growth by 0.4 percentage points in 2026.
The challenges were already there to see as the volunteers worked on the slopes of Ladany valley.
Borbala Kanizsay, who was there with her husband, said the creek that ran past their nearby house ran dry in May for the first time she could remember. Most of her parched trees shed their leaves in July.
A "terrible sight," the 41-year-old added. "We must adapt to this situation that our climate has changed, and we must strive to keep Hungary a liveable place."

Kentaro Okasaka　Kyu-seok Shim　Brenda Goh

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - 日本と韓国でサイバー攻撃が相次ぎ、政府や企業が早急な対応を迫られている。クラウドサービスも攻撃された日本ではここ数週間で情報漏えいが急増し、韓国では複数の金融機関が同時に被害を受けた。専門家は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及で高度な技術を持たない犯罪者でも攻撃を仕掛けやすくなり、サイバー犯罪がより手軽かつ低コストになっていると警鐘を鳴らす。

＜「危急の状況」、政府に強まる警戒感＞

足元で急増する日本企業への不正アクセスは、金融の大和証券や損保ジャパン、小売りのブックオフグループホールディングスやローソン、飲食の焼肉きんぐ、カーシェアを運営するタイムズモビリティなど業界を問わず広範にわたる。特にソフトバンク子会社でクラウド事業を手がけるＩＤＣフロンティアが攻撃を受けた影響は大きく、契約する４９５の企業と自治体でサイトが閲覧できなくなったり、情報が流出したりした。今も復旧しておらず、保管していた一部のデータは復元や取り出しが困難だという。

「事案の背景や相互の関連性などは明らかではないが、情報収集を行い実態把握に努めている」。木原稔官房長官が会見でこう語った日本政府は８日、関係省庁会議を開いて対応を協議した。経済産業省は９日、所管する業界団体を通じて幅広く注意喚起することを明らかにした。金融庁は同日、金融機関などに対しサイバーセキュリティー対策の強化と本人確認手続きの厳格化を求める注意喚起を行った。

韓国では銀行９行や大型教会が、ＡＩツールが使われた可能性のあるサイバー攻撃を受けている。米サイバーセキュリティー企業クラウドストライクは、背後にいるとみられる中国在住の２６歳の容疑者について、ＡＩの支援なしには今回の攻撃を実行できなかった可能性が高いとの見方を示した。この人物は金銭的利益を目的としており、中国製のＡＩエージェントや米ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの「クロード・コード」を使用していたという。

同社の対敵対者作戦担当シニア・バイスプレジデント、アダム・マイヤーズ氏は、「（ハッカーの）能力はそれほど高度ではなかったが、十分に効果的だった」と述べた。その上で、韓国の銀行への攻撃事案は、ＡＩの進化に伴い、より強固なセキュリティー管理体制と厳格な検証の必要性を浮き彫りにしたと語った。「いわば、パンドラの箱は開けられた」

ＡＩは攻撃を容易にするだけでなく、防御側が不審な動きを見つけることも難しくしている。韓国・嘉泉大学のチェ・ギョンジン氏は「汎用ＡＩモデルを使えば、悪意を持った一般の利用者でも脆弱性を探すよう指示するだけで、その作業の多くをＡＩに任せることができる」と指摘する。

＜日本語の「壁」を越えるＡＩ＞

日本の場合、不正アクセスが続発している原因がＡＩの進化と関係しているのかまだ分かっていない。ただ、専門家によると、ＡＩを使えばソフトウエアの脆弱性探索やフィッシング攻撃に使う文章の作成などを自動化できる。攻撃にかかる時間やコストが減る一方、発見は難しくなっているという。

トレンドＡＩによると、日本に拠点を置く組織のサイバーセキュリティー事案は今年１─９月ですでに昨年１年間を上回った。９月は８６件と、８月から約１８％、７月からは約３７％増えた。９日もＪＲ東日本や旅行サイトのスカイチケットが情報流出を発表した。

サイバーセキュリティー会社、Ｓ＆Ｊ（東京都港区）の三輪信雄社長は「チャットＧＰＴの性能が上がったのと同じで、サイバー攻撃もどこかでこれまでの常識が通じないほどのブレークスルーを迎えた」と指摘する。これまで海外のハッカーは日本語という「壁」に守られた日本企業を敬遠しがちだったが、ＡＩを使えば言語の垣根はなくなる。「ＡＩに苦手はない。英語圏は大概、刈り尽くし、今回は日本が特にじゅうたん爆撃のようにやられている」と語る。

＜防御側はギアを２段階上げる必要＞

ＡＩを悪用したサイバー攻撃の広がりには、ＡＩを開発する側も警戒を強めている。アルファベット傘下のグーグルと、アンソロピックはいずれも、ＡＩを使った攻撃が世界的に増加していると警告している。グーグルの脅威インテリジェンス・グループのチーフアナリスト、ジョン・ハルトクイスト氏は先月、「現時点で、すべての脅威アクターが何らかの形でＡＩを使い、その恩恵を受けていると考えていい」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｊの三輪氏は、「オンラインでＢｔｏＣ（消費者向け事業）をやっている会社の数からすると（攻撃された企業数は）ほんのひとかけらで、刈り尽くすまではまだまだ時間はかかる。今後も（件数は）高止まりするだろう」と語る。「攻撃を受けてから会議を開いていては間に合わない。われわれの対応もギアを２段階上げ、ブレークスルーしていかないといけない」

（岡坂健太郎、Kyu-Seok Shim、Brenda Goh、Sam Nussey　編集：久保信博）

[東京 ９日 ロイター] - 日本と韓国でサイバー攻撃が相次ぎ、政府や企業が早急な対応を迫られている。クラウドサービスも攻撃された日本ではここ数週間で情報漏えいが急増し、韓国では複数の金融機関が同時に被害を受けた。専門家は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及で高度な技術を持たない犯罪者でも攻撃を仕掛けやすくなり、サイバー犯罪がより手軽かつ低コストになっていると警鐘を鳴らす。

＜「危急の状況」、政府に強まる警戒感＞

足元で急増する日本企業への不正アクセスは、金融の大和証券や損保ジャパン、小売りのブックオフグループホールディングスやローソン、飲食の焼肉きんぐ、カーシェアを運営するタイムズモビリティなど業界を問わず広範にわたる。特にソフトバンク子会社でクラウド事業を手がけるＩＤＣフロンティアが攻撃を受けた影響は大きく、契約する４９５の企業と自治体でサイトが閲覧できなくなったり、情報が流出したりした。今も復旧しておらず、保管していた一部のデータは復元や取り出しが困難だという。

「事案の背景や相互の関連性などは明らかではないが、情報収集を行い実態把握に努めている」。木原稔官房長官が会見でこう語った日本政府は８日、関係省庁会議を開いて対応を協議した。経済産業省は９日、所管する業界団体を通じて幅広く注意喚起することを明らかにした。金融庁は同日、金融機関などに対しサイバーセキュリティー対策の強化と本人確認手続きの厳格化を求める注意喚起を行った。

韓国では銀行９行や大型教会が、ＡＩツールが使われた可能性のあるサイバー攻撃を受けている。米サイバーセキュリティー企業クラウドストライクは、背後にいるとみられる中国在住の２６歳の容疑者について、ＡＩの支援なしには今回の攻撃を実行できなかった可能性が高いとの見方を示した。この人物は金銭的利益を目的としており、中国製のＡＩエージェントや米ＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの「クロード・コード」を使用していたという。

同社の対敵対者作戦担当シニア・バイスプレジデント、アダム・マイヤーズ氏は、「（ハッカーの）能力はそれほど高度ではなかったが、十分に効果的だった」と述べた。その上で、韓国の銀行への攻撃事案は、ＡＩの進化に伴い、より強固なセキュリティー管理体制と厳格な検証の必要性を浮き彫りにしたと語った。「いわば、パンドラの箱は開けられた」

ＡＩは攻撃を容易にするだけでなく、防御側が不審な動きを見つけることも難しくしている。韓国・嘉泉大学のチェ・ギョンジン氏は「汎用ＡＩモデルを使えば、悪意を持った一般の利用者でも脆弱性を探すよう指示するだけで、その作業の多くをＡＩに任せることができる」と指摘する。

＜日本語の「壁」を越えるＡＩ＞

日本の場合、不正アクセスが続発している原因がＡＩの進化と関係しているのかまだ分かっていない。ただ、専門家によると、ＡＩを使えばソフトウエアの脆弱性探索やフィッシング攻撃に使う文章の作成などを自動化できる。攻撃にかかる時間やコストが減る一方、発見は難しくなっているという。

トレンドＡＩによると、日本に拠点を置く組織のサイバーセキュリティー事案は今年１─９月ですでに昨年１年間を上回った。９月は８６件と、８月から約１８％、７月からは約３７％増えた。９日もＪＲ東日本や旅行サイトのスカイチケットが情報流出を発表した。

サイバーセキュリティー会社、Ｓ＆Ｊ（東京都港区）の三輪信雄社長は「チャットＧＰＴの性能が上がったのと同じで、サイバー攻撃もどこかでこれまでの常識が通じないほどのブレークスルーを迎えた」と指摘する。これまで海外のハッカーは日本語という「壁」に守られた日本企業を敬遠しがちだったが、ＡＩを使えば言語の垣根はなくなる。「ＡＩに苦手はない。英語圏は大概、刈り尽くし、今回は日本が特にじゅうたん爆撃のようにやられている」と語る。

＜防御側はギアを２段階上げる必要＞

ＡＩを悪用したサイバー攻撃の広がりには、ＡＩを開発する側も警戒を強めている。アルファベット傘下のグーグルと、アンソロピックはいずれも、ＡＩを使った攻撃が世界的に増加していると警告している。グーグルの脅威インテリジェンス・グループのチーフアナリスト、ジョン・ハルトクイスト氏は先月、「現時点で、すべての脅威アクターが何らかの形でＡＩを使い、その恩恵を受けていると考えていい」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｊの三輪氏は、「オンラインでＢｔｏＣ（消費者向け事業）をやっている会社の数からすると（攻撃された企業数は）ほんのひとかけらで、刈り尽くすまではまだまだ時間はかかる。今後も（件数は）高止まりするだろう」と語る。「攻撃を受けてから会議を開いていては間に合わない。われわれの対応もギアを２段階上げ、ブレークスルーしていかないといけない」

（岡坂健太郎、Kyu-Seok Shim、Brenda Goh、Sam Nussey　編集：久保信博）

items.title: Estados Unidos reporta exportación de petróleo a México por 600.000 barriles
items.author: Arturo Solís
items.summary: Ciudad de México — Estados Unidos reportó exportaciones de petróleo crudo a México por 598.000 barriles, el primer cargamento desde 2018, de acuerdo con datos compilados por Bloomberg Línea.
items.body: Ciudad de México — Estados Unidos reportó exportaciones de petróleo crudo a México por 598.000 barriles, el primer cargamento desde 2018, de acuerdo con datos compilados por Bloomberg Línea. La Oficina del Censo de Estados Unidos informó que el valor del cargamento a México es de US$69,7 millones con una calidad de crudo de 25 o más grados API, el cual fue realizado desde el distrito de la ciudad portuaria de Nueva Orleans en el estado de Luisiana. Ver más: México reduce subsidios a gasolinas y sigue sin recaudar diésel tras liberación de reservas del G7 Las importaciones mexicanas de crudo por casi 600.000 barriles ocurrieron en mayo y junio de 2026, reiteró la base de datos de la Agencia de Información Energética, conocida como EIA. Pero existe un antecedente que hace necesario verificar la información. En octubre de 2019, la Oficina del Censo rectificó, luego de haber confirmado previamente el reporte de la exportación a México por 541.000 barriles de crudo entre julio y agosto de ese año y corrigió su base de datos, después de que el Gobierno mexicano negó la información. Bloomberg Línea consultó a la Oficina del Censo y EIA, además de la Secretaría de Energía de México y Pemex, pero no obtuvo respuesta inmediata. Ver más: México busca sumar reservas petroleras con la menor probabilidad de extracción El Gobierno de la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum continuó la política energética de autosuficiencia petrolera de su predecesor López Obrador, quien criticó fuertemente las importaciones de crudo que realizó Pemex en 2018, pero actualmente los retrasos en obras clave del negocio de refinación han impedido alcanzar el objetivo de producir toda las gasolinas y diésel que demanda el país con el crudo que extrae Pemex. AMLO, como se conoce al mandatario, calificó las importaciones de crudo como una muestra del fracaso de la política económica neoliberal de los últimos 30 años. El 22 de octubre de 2018, Pemex informó en un comunicado que su brazo comercial PMI asignó cargamentos para la importación de 1,4 millones de barriles de crudo ligero Bakken con el objetivo de mejorar la calidad del petróleo crudo utilizado en el Sistema Nacional de Refinación. Las refinerías de Pemex fueron construidas para procesar crudos ligeros, pero la tendencia de producción del país ha cambiado a hacia aceites pesados, además de enfrentar el declive más grande en 40 años. El periódico local El Financiero reportó previamente el envío de crudo a México.

items.title: EU ministers reach watered down compromise on centralised cap markets supervision
items.author: Jan Strupczewski
items.creator: Jan Strupczewski
items.summary: European Union finance ministers agreed on Friday a scaled-back compromise to centralise supervision of most EU stock exchanges, central counterparties and securities depositories as they seek to make the EU capital markets work better.
items.body:
European Union finance ministers agreed on Friday a scaled-back compromise to centralise supervision of most EU stock exchanges, central counterparties and securities depositories as they seek to make the EU capital markets work better.
The deal aims to reduce the fragmentation of 27 different legal systems government capital flows and make the EU more attractive to innovative companies, which now often choose to relocate to the United States.
But it differs from the original proposal for the Market Integration and Supervision Package made by the European Commission. That envisaged all stock exchanges, large central counterparties (CCPs) and central securities depositories (CSDs) being supervised by the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) in Paris, rather than by national authorities as now.
"People can hold out for the perfect, or people can hold hands and jump together with the good," said Simon Harris, finance minister of Ireland, who was in charge of negotiating the compromise.
The idea behind the single supervisor was to help apply the same EU laws in the same way across all countries, eliminating national interpretations to reduce costs and bureaucracy.
But Germany refused to support the proposal unless its Deutsche Boerse stock exchange remained under local German supervision. The compromise introduces trading thresholds and geographical footprint criteria that would allow the German stock exchange to be exempt from ESMA oversight.
The criteria also exclude Swiss exchange operator SIX Group, which has the Madrid bourse and Aquis, as well as French-owned Tradition and Deutsche Boerse-owned electronic trading platform Tradegate (T2GG.F) .
The compromise also removed three out of the original nine CCPs from under ESMA's jurisdiction — the Dutch CBOE Clear, Spain's BME and Sweden's Nasdaq Clearing.
The initial 15 CSDs that were to fall under ESMA were reduced to 13, with Spain's Iberclear and the Baltic's Nasdaq CSD removed. Only between 10 to 15 from around 360 crypto-asset service providers in the EU will be subject to ESMA oversight, officials said.
Smaller EU countries also won concessions that give national supervisors greater influence in ESMA decision-making.
Negotiations on the final shape of the law will continue with the European Parliament, once the EU legislature reaches its own position on the issue.

items.title: Maioria bipartidária nos EUA atribui aumento dos custos a políticas de Trump, aponta Reuters/Ipsos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cerca de 78% dos norte-americanos atribuem às políticas do presidente Donald Trump o aumento dos preços, que está superando o crescimento de seus rendimentos, de acordo com uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos que revelou que a maioria dos republicanos e democratas cita o custo de vida como sua principal preocupação antes das eleições de meio de mandato do próximo mês.
items.body:
Cerca de 78% dos norte-americanos atribuem às políticas do presidente Donald Trump o aumento dos preços, que está superando o crescimento de seus rendimentos, de acordo com uma pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos que revelou que a maioria dos republicanos e democratas cita o custo de vida como sua principal preocupação antes das eleições de meio de mandato do próximo mês.
Cinquenta e sete por cento dos republicanos afirmaram que os custos vêm crescendo mais rapidamente do que seus salários, um exemplo gritante de como a busca de Trump por tarifas de importação, guerra com o Irã e outras políticas entraram em conflito com uma promessa central de campanha para 2024: acabar com a inflação e reduzir os preços “desde o primeiro dia”.
Em vez disso, a inflação aumentou, a ponto de o Federal Reserve dos EUA ter mudado de rumo para aumentos nas taxas de juros a fim de conter os aumentos de preços que os formuladores de políticas atribuíram a uma variedade de fatores, incluindo o aumento dos custos globais de energia após o início da guerra com o Irã e a imposição de impostos agressivos sobre as importações pelo governo.
As preocupações com a economia e a guerra levaram a aprovação pública de Trump a níveis recordes de baixa e têm pesado sobre o apoio ao seu Partido Republicano antes da eleição de 3 de novembro, que determinará o controle do Congresso pelos próximos dois anos.
Cerca de um em cada quatro republicanos desaprova a maneira como Trump lidou com a economia, opinião compartilhada por 63% dos independentes e 92% dos democratas. A desaprovação foi ainda mais acentuada no que diz respeito à inflação, com 68% de todos os entrevistados e 40% dos republicanos insatisfeitos.
Jeffrey Talley, de 65 anos, um auditor bancário aposentado de Mission Hills, no Kansas, é um republicano registrado que afirmou ter votado em Trump em 2016, mas não em 2020 nem em 2024, e agora planeja votar no democrata Adam Hamilton naquilo que se tornou uma disputa pelo Senado inesperadamente acirrada no Estado.
“Sou totalmente contra todo esse absurdo que está acontecendo no Oriente Médio com a guerra contra o Irã e o aumento do preço da gasolina... isso tem sido muito desanimador”, disse Talley. Ele vê a eleição como uma chance de eleger “alguém que possa exercer um freio e contrapeso à loucura que está acontecendo na Casa Branca”.
A pesquisa Reuters/Ipsos, realizada online em todo o país durante seis dias e concluída na segunda-feira, coletou respostas de 4.506 adultos norte-americanos. Ela teve uma margem de erro de 2 pontos percentuais para os norte-americanos em geral e de 3 pontos para republicanos, democratas e independentes.

items.title: China, EU reach hybrid vehicle trade understanding, keep talks alive on EV dispute
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China and the European Union reached an "understanding" on trade in hybrid vehicles, the Chinese commerce ministry said on Friday, after two days of talks in which the bloc sought to reduce its trade deficit with Beijing.
items.body:
China and the European Union reached an "understanding" on trade in hybrid vehicles, the Chinese commerce ministry said on Friday, after two days of talks in which the bloc sought to reduce its trade deficit with Beijing.
European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic has said he was seeking "[USN:L6N4500OS TEXT:"tangible results"]" from his visit to China, amid the bloc's growing concerns over the gap, which amounted to over €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day.
The understanding on hybrid vehicle trade in a WTO-compliant manner followed intensive negotiations, the Chinese ministry said, without giving details.
Asked whether the Chinese statement was a joint one, the European Commission said Sefcovic would comment on the talks at a press conference at 1300 GMT.
CHINESE CAR IMPORTS TO EU HAVE RISEN SHARPLY EU officials are concerned by the sharp rise in car imports from China. Imports of plug-in hybrids into the EU have increased 86% in the year to September, with a 20% decline in prices. More than half of these vehicles are now from China, while for 2025, China's share of PHEV imports was 30% in value terms.
The discussions between Commerce Minister Wang Wentao and Sefcovic in Beijing on Thursday and Friday were "pragmatic and productive," the Chinese ministry said.
China and the EU also agreed to continue discussions on price undertakings and review procedures related to the EU's anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese electric vehicles, according to the ministry.
China and EU's dispute over cheap Chinese EV exports, dating to 2024, has clouded bilateral ties, and has since broadened to include sectors such as brandy, pork and dairy, as well as rare earths and critical minerals.
China needs foreign buyers for the flood of cheap, state-subsidised goods its own shoppers can't absorb, and the EU is torn between welcoming those imports to ease living costs and keeping them out to rebuild its own factories.
Both sides will keep exploring the possibility of lowering tariffs on certain goods within the framework of WTO rules, and continue their dialogue on market access for medical devices, the Chinese ministry said.
A third regular meeting of their consultation mechanism will take place in March 2027, and the two sides agreed to maintain communication, including a ministerial-level video conference in January, the ministry said.
($1 = 0.8920 euros)

items.title: Bahn drosselt Tempo bei Sanierung - Weniger Großbaustellen bis 2031
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die Deutsche Bahn und die Bundesregierung drosseln das Tempo bei der Sanierung des maroden Schienennetzes, um für mehr Verlässlichkeit bei den Bauarbeiten und im Zugverkehr zu sorgen. Bis 2031 sollen nur noch 13 statt der bisher geplanten 21 Hauptstrecken grundlegend modernisiert werden, wie das Bundesverkehrsministerium und der Staatskonzern(DBN.UL) am Freitag mitteilten. "Die Idee der Korridorsanierungen ist richtig", sagte Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger. "In der Vergangenheit hat die Umsetzung jedoch zu oft nicht die gewünschten Ergebnisse gebracht." Deshalb ziehe man jetzt Konsequenzen. Künftig müsse der Bahnbetrieb nach Sanierungen spürbar verlässlicher und pünktlicher werden.
items.body:
Die Deutsche Bahn und die Bundesregierung drosseln das Tempo bei der Sanierung des maroden Schienennetzes, um für mehr Verlässlichkeit bei den Bauarbeiten und im Zugverkehr zu sorgen. Bis 2031 sollen nur noch 13 statt der bisher geplanten 21 Hauptstrecken grundlegend modernisiert werden, wie das Bundesverkehrsministerium und der Staatskonzern(DBN.UL) am Freitag mitteilten. "Die Idee der Korridorsanierungen ist richtig", sagte Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger. "In der Vergangenheit hat die Umsetzung jedoch zu oft nicht die gewünschten Ergebnisse gebracht." Deshalb ziehe man jetzt Konsequenzen. Künftig müsse der Bahnbetrieb nach Sanierungen spürbar verlässlicher und pünktlicher werden.
"Dafür konzentrieren wir uns auf weniger Korridore, setzen klarere Vorgaben für die Digitalisierung und verlangen eine bessere Planung der Bauvorhaben sowie der Umleitungsverkehre für den Personen- und Güterverkehr", sagte der CDU-Politiker. Die Maßnahme soll die umfangreichen Bauarbeiten verlässlicher machen und die knappen Kapazitäten im Schienennetz berücksichtigen.
Bahn-Chefin Evelyn Palla erklärte, man habe aus den ersten Sanierungen gelernt. "Wir wollen die Sanierungen effizienter umsetzen und vor allem die Belastungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden während der Bauarbeiten so gering wie möglich halten."
Kern der neuen Strategie ist ein Fünf-Punkte-Plan. Dieser sieht unter anderem ein besseres Vorbereiten von Umleitungsstrecken und eine schrittweise Inbetriebnahme der sanierten Korridore vor. Zudem soll das digitale europäische Zugsicherheitssystem ETCS zum neuen Standard werden. Bei jeder Sanierung soll die Technik künftig vorbereitet und ab Anfang der 2030er-Jahre direkt verbaut werden.
"ENDLICH KONSEQUENZEN AUS FEHLERN BISHERIGER SANIERUNGEN" Das neue Konzept sei zu kaum mehr geeignet, als den Bundeshaushalt zu entlasten, sagte Bahn-Experte Matthias Gastel von den Grünen der "Rheinischen Post". "Pünktlicher werden die Züge auf weiter modernisierungsbedürftiger Infrastruktur nicht."
Die Konkurrenz im Güterverkehr hat in der Vergangenheit die langwierigen Sanierungen kritisiert. Die Geschäftsführerin des Verbands der Güterbahnen, Neele Wesseln, begrüßte, dass Bund und Bahn "endlich Konsequenzen aus den Fehlern der bisherigen Korridorsanierungen ziehen". Irritierend sei aber, dass Bilger sich bereits bei der Branche für eine gemeinsam erarbeitete, tragfähige Lösung bedanke, obwohl der Dialog der Branche gerade erst begonnen habe. "Wir wollen nicht nachträglich eine Lösung abnicken, sondern ihre Ausgestaltung mitbestimmen."
Rückendeckung für das Umsteuern kommt von Unions-Fraktionsvize Stephan Stracke. Bauzeiten müssten realistisch geplant und eingehalten, Ersatzverkehre verlässlich organisiert werden, sagte der CSU-Politiker der "Rheinischen Post". "Die zeitliche Streckung der Korridorsanierungen sorgt dafür, dass all dies künftig besser funktionieren kann.". Das sei man den Menschen schuldig, "die tagtäglich auf den Zug angewiesen sind".
Die Sanierungen werden den Angaben zufolge nicht gestrichen, sondern nur zeitlich verschoben. Den Zeitplan für die Großbaustellen ab 2032 soll es erst im nächsten Jahr geben. Für 2027 sind Arbeiten an den Strecken Lehrte-Berlin, Rosenheim-Salzburg und Fulda-Hanau geplant. 2029 etwa sollen unter anderem die wichtigen Verbindungen Hamburg-Hannover und Aachen-Köln folgen. Nach Abschluss der jeweiligen Baustelle sollen die Strecken danach "möglichst bis zu zehn Jahre weitgehend frei von größeren baubedingten Einschränkungen" bleiben.
Trotz der Probleme bei der Umsetzung verteidigten Bahn und Regierung das Grundprinzip der Generalsanierungen. Auf der sanierten Riedbahn zwischen Frankfurt und Mannheim etwa fahren den Angaben zufolge Züge nun 20 Prozent pünktlicher aus dem Abschnitt heraus, als sie hineinfahren. Auf der Strecke Nürnberg-Regensburg seien die Störungen durch die Infrastruktur seit Abschluss der Arbeiten um über 90 Prozent zurückgegangen.

BENGALURU, Oct 9 : India's telecom minister said on Friday the country does not allow monopolies in any sector, pushing back after Elon Musk suggested billionaire Mukesh Ambani was using political influence to block Starlink's launch in the country.
"India does not allow a monopoly in any sector," telecom minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said at a media briefing on Friday, addressing Musk's remarks.
Musk's SpaceX unit is seeking entry into a telecom market with more than a billion internet users, currently dominated by the mobile networks of Ambani's Reliance Jio and Sunil Mittal's Bharti Airtel.
"Is Ambani the real boss of India?", Musk wrote on X on Thursday, questioning why Starlink still lacked a license despite what he said were years of compliance with Indian requirements. He provided no evidence against Ambani.

Ambani's Reliance Jio did not respond to a request for comments on Musk's remarks.
A four-year wait to launch Starlink's satellite internet services in India has sparked heated exchanges online over business influence and regulatory delays, with Musk targeting Ambani and the political opposition joining the row.
While Starlink has already secured a licence to operate in India, a commercial launch still requires it to meet security compliance conditions and receive a spectrum assignment.
The government said on Thursday that all three licensed satellite operators including Starlink were at broadly the same regulatory stage, calling suggestions of an unfair or discriminatory process "baseless and misconceived".

Source: Reuters

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aventaja a Lula por seis puntos en encuesta para segunda vuelta en Brasil
items.author: Beatriz Reis
items.summary: El senador Flávio Bolsonaro obtendría el 53% de los votos válidos frente al 47% del presidente Lula da Silva en la segunda vuelta del 25 de octubre, según una encuesta de AtlasIntel para Bloomberg New ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Según una nueva encuesta, el aspirante de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro aventaja al actual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva de cara a la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil, aprovechando el impulso obtenido tras su sorprendente resultado en la primera vuelta. Bolsonaro obtendría alrededor del 53% de los votos válidos frente al 47% de Lula, excluyendo las papeletas en blanco e inválidas, según una encuesta de AtlasIntel para Bloomberg News publicada el viernes. Ver más: Cinco claves que siguen los mercados rumbo al balotaje entre Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro en Brasil El senador obtuvo cerca del 47% de los votos válidos frente al 45% de Lula en la primera vuelta del domingo, mientras que los aliados conservadores dominaron las elecciones al Congreso, lo que preparó a Brasil para un amplio giro a la derecha. La última encuesta de AtlasIntel de la primera vuelta había proyectado una ventaja del 47% para Lula frente al 44% en la votación inicial. Una victoria de Bolsonaro sumaría a la nación más grande de América Latina a una ola regional de derecha que ha visto a aliados conservadores del presidente estadounidense Donald Trump ganar elecciones recientes en Chile, Colombia y Perú. Los mercados repuntaron tras la primera vuelta de las elecciones, ya que los inversores apostaron a que Bolsonaro tiene más probabilidades de impulsar políticas para abordar el deterioro de la situación fiscal de Brasil y, en última instancia, crear margen para reducir los tipos de interés. Ver más: “El partido está por comenzar”, dice Lula; Flávio afirma que hará una campaña “limpia” Bolsonaro, el hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, ha obtenido desde entonces el respaldo de numerosos partidos de centro y centroderecha de cara a la segunda vuelta. Mientras tanto, Lula ha declarado que planea dirigirse a los aproximadamente 33 millones de votantes que no emitieron su voto en la primera ronda, instándolos a participar en la segunda vuelta del 25 de octubre mediante una serie de publicaciones en las redes sociales. Bolsonaro promete políticas de seguridad más estrictas y lazos más estrechos con Estados Unidos, aunque el jueves afirmó que también trabajaría con China , el mayor socio comercial de Brasil. Algunos de los nombres que se han barajado para gestionar la economía de Brasil en caso de que gane incluyen a Marcelo Kayath, Mansueto Almeida, Roberto Campos Neto y Alexandre Bettamio, informó Bloomberg News el jueves, citando a personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil 2026: qué proponen Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro en economía, seguridad y energía Lula está haciendo campaña a favor de una mayor protección social, los derechos de los trabajadores y una política exterior multilateral que ha caracterizado gran parte de su tiempo en el poder. El presidente de izquierdas aumentó las prestaciones sociales y prohibió el juego en línea antes de la primera vuelta de las elecciones, en un esfuerzo por aliviar la presión sobre los hogares que luchan contra las deudas y el creciente costo de vida. Pero la economía sigue siendo uno de sus mayores desafíos. La inflación y los altos costos de endeudamiento están afectando a los consumidores justo cuando el crecimiento pierde impulso, lo que agrava las dificultades de una campaña que Lula describió como “la más desorganizada” que ha llevado a cabo en sus décadas de carrera política. AtlasIntel encuestó a 5.026 votantes entre el 3 y el 8 de octubre. La encuesta tiene un nivel de confianza del 95%, un margen de error de más o menos 1 punto porcentual y está registrada en el tribunal electoral del país con el número BR-03663/2026. Netflix (NFLX.O) is planning to cut about 5% of its workforce, with an announcement expected as early as next week, Puck News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Netflix declined to comment on the report.
The streaming giant's [USN:L4N2YA2WX TEXT:"last major round"] of layoffs came in 2022, when the company cut hundreds of jobs amid slowing growth and subscriber losses
Netflix had about 16,000 full-time employees at the end of last year
The company is navigating an increasingly competitive streaming market, as media companies consolidate and YouTube captures a growing share of viewership and advertising spending
Netflix has been expanding beyond its subscription business, investing in advertising, live programming and gaming to diversify its revenue sources

items.title: Hurkacz hands Djokovic early Shanghai exit with first win over Serb
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Poland's Hubert Hurkacz beat Novak Djokovic for the first time as he dumped the four-times champion out of the Shanghai Masters with a 6-4 6-3 second-round victory on Friday.
items.body:
Poland's Hubert Hurkacz beat Novak Djokovic for the first time as he dumped the four-times champion out of the Shanghai Masters with a 6-4 6-3 second-round victory on Friday.
Tenth seed Djokovic arrived in Shanghai fresh from winning a [USN:L6N45S0UI TEXT:"record seventh China Open"] crown after Australia's Alex de Minaur retired with a groin injury in Tuesday's final.
The 24-times Grand Slam champion, whose last Shanghai title came in 2018, had an 8-0 record against 29-year-old Hurkacz.
But the Pole, a former world number six, produced a clinical display, firing 13 aces and 28 winners while conceding little on serve to beat Djokovic in one hour and 27 minutes in his first Shanghai appearance since capturing the title in 2023.
Hurkacz, who missed the tournament in 2024 and 2025, extended his winning streak in Shanghai to eight matches and now faces either Italy's Lorenzo Musetti or China's Zhou Yi.
The defeat marked the latest setback in a testing season for the 39-year-old Serbian, who suffered a shock first-round exit at the US Open, his earliest Grand Slam defeat since the 2006 Australian Open.
"I was not close to what I was playing in Beijing," Djokovic said. "I'm slightly more tired, not fresh ...
"I didn't feel myself on the court in terms of feeling the ball. It's a super quick surface, completely different from Beijing.
"If you lose your serve, it is enough to lose the match, once per set, and that is what happened. It is very difficult to return his serve, almost impossible. So yeah, I did not adjust and it was a really tough draw for me, playing him in the first match."
Djokovic will now turn his attention to the European indoor swing, with next month's Paris Masters looming. He is ninth in the race for a spot at the season-ending ATP Finals in Turin.
"I am planning on only playing in Paris, so let's see. Hopefully I can have a good result there," he added.
TOP SEED ZVEREV MARCHES ON French and US Open champion Zverev remained firmly on track in Shanghai in his bid to secure the year-end world number one ranking by seeing off local favourite Wu Yibing 6-4 7-6(4).
The German world number two can ensure he will reach the pinnacle by the end of the year if he makes the semi-finals or if his nearest challengers Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton lose at any stage of the Masters 1000 tournament.
[USN:L1N45S0CV TEXT:"Jannik Sinner"] is currently the top-ranked player, but the Italian ended his season prematurely due to inflammation in his knee and will drop the points he earned for winning the Vienna Open, the Paris Masters and the ATP Finals last year.
The only blemish on an otherwise perfect day for top seed Zverev was a minor injury scare at 5-5 in the second set, when the 29-year-old slipped and fell near the baseline and then clutched his left ankle.
Memories of the serious ankle injury he suffered in the 2022 French Open semi-finals briefly resurfaced but Zverev recovered and completed the win in the ensuing tiebreak to book a meeting with Frenchman Quentin Halys.
Earlier, US Open runner-up Shelton celebrated his 24th birthday with a 6-3 7-6(6) win over German Daniel Altmaier but it was the end of the road for Roland Garros finalist Flavio Cobolli, who fell 6-1 4-6 6-3 to Frenchman Adrian Mannarino.

items.title: Renoir paintings stolen from Riviera museum recovered, six people arrested
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two Renoir paintings worth millions of dollars that were stolen from a museum on the French Riviera a month ago have been recovered and six suspects have been arrested, the local mayor said on Friday.
items.body:
Two Renoir paintings worth millions of dollars that were stolen from a museum on the French Riviera a month ago have been recovered and six suspects have been arrested, the local mayor said on Friday.
Thieves had [USN:L8N4500AJ TEXT:"broken into"] the grounds of the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer early in the morning of September 8 through a hole cut in a garden fence and entered through a window.
The two paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, an Impressionist whose works have fetched tens of millions of dollars at auction, were "Madame Colonna Romano" and "Young Woman at the Well". Both belong to Paris' Orsay Museum and were on loan.
"This news is a source of immense joy and a great relief for the town of Cagnes-sur-Mer and its residents," mayor Bryan Masson said in a statement.
The Marseille public prosecutor's office did not immediately respond to questions about how the paintings had been recovered. The mayor scheduled a press conference on Thursday afternoon then cancelled it so as not to interfere with the investigation.
The thieves had also snatched two other paintings, "Madame Pichon" and "Coco Reading", a portrayal of Claude, Renoir's young son. But they dropped them in the gardens as police, alerted by alarms, arrived and gave chase.

Qualcomm and Arm set for jury verdict in contract breach feud

WILMINGTON, Delaware, Oct 9 : A lawsuit by chipmaker Qualcomm against chip technology supplier Arm Holdings will head on Friday to a jury charged with determining if Arm breached licensing agreements and intentionally sabotaged some of Qualcomm's dealings with Meta Platforms.
The five-day trial is the second in two years between the companies and highlights the deterioration of their business relationship after SoftBank Group Corp acquired control of Arm in 2016 and Arm shifted from licensing the technology needed to make chips to selling chips of its own. At stake is whether Qualcomm, whose license for Arm's computing architecture runs until 2033, can eventually agree to terms for new versions of Arm's architecture.
Qualcomm wants the jury to find that Arm breached its licensing agreements by withholding software patches and tools for its designs and by violating an agreement that was meant to ensure Qualcomm paid within 10 per cent of the lowest price for Arm's processor designs.
It also wants the jury to find that Arm tried to torpedo Qualcomm's dealings with Meta by leaking to Bloomberg an Arm letter in 2024 notifying Qualcomm it was allegedly in breach of a key license agreement.

Arm's legal team this week tried to focus the jury on its claim that Qualcomm had not suffered any harm from the allegations in its lawsuit, which Arm cast as an attempt to exert leverage as the two fought over licensing terms. A related bench trial also took place this week over whether Arm is negotiating in good faith over those terms, though a decision on that could come well after Friday's verdict.
The trial in Wilmington, Delaware, federal court hinged on many of the same episodes as the 2024 trial in which Arm failed to convince a jury that Qualcomm had breached its licensing agreement with Arm. Both trials included testimony by both Arm CEO Rene Haas and Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon and were overseen by US District Judge Maryellen Noreika.
Qualcomm's lawyer Karen Dunn said in her opening statement that the case was very serious for the company.
"It’s really bad because Qualcomm’s entire chip business depends on Arm and on Arm honoring its contract and honoring its promises," she said on Monday.
Qualcomm wanted Noreika to rule prior to trial that a clause in the licensing agreements meant that Qualcomm could stop paying royalties for five years if the contract were breached. She has not issued her ruling, and Arm has argued the royalty penalty is unenforceable.
"They were not harmed in the least," Arm's attorney Gregg LoCascio told the jury on Monday. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: El dólar extiende su racha alcista más larga desde principios de 2025
items.author: Anya Andrianova, Melos Ambaye
items.summary: La tensión con Irán, el encarecimiento del petróleo y las expectativas de nuevas subidas de tasas en Estados Unidos respaldan a la divisa.
items.body: Bloomberg — La apreciación del dólar continúa imparable a medida que el alza vertiginosa de los precios del petróleo presiona a las monedas de los países importadores de energía y persisten los temores a la inflación mundial. El índice Bloomberg Dollar Spot extiende su avance por cuarta semana consecutiva, registrando una ganancia de casi el 3% en este periodo, su racha alcista más larga desde principios de 2025. Ver más: ¿El precio del dólar seguirá subiendo? BlackRock explica por qué ve poco margen para otro rally Si bien el indicador se mantuvo estable el viernes, se ha visto respaldado por los elevados precios del petróleo en medio de los recientes ataques de Irán, que amenazan los flujos energéticos en Medio Oriente e impulsan a los inversores hacia la moneda refugio. “La aversión al riesgo, las preocupaciones fiscales en Europa y el temor a interrupciones en el suministro desde el estrecho de Ormuz siguen impulsando a los inversores hacia el dólar ante la falta de alternativas”, afirmó Sarah Ying, jefa de estrategia de divisas de CIBC Capital Markets. “Hasta que los precios del petróleo vuelvan a bajar, prevemos un período de fortaleza sostenida del dólar”. Otro factor que impulsa al dólar es la capacidad de Estados Unidos para soportar mayores aumentos de las tasas de interés que otras grandes economías. Las preocupaciones fiscales en Francia y los altos precios de la energía han presionado al euro, que a principios de esta semana alcanzó su nivel más bajo desde mayo de 2025. “Creo que parte del argumento alcista para el dólar reside en la sólida justificación de tipos de interés más altos en términos relativos”, dijo Robert Tipp, estratega jefe de inversiones y director de bonos globales de PGIM Fixed Income. El mes pasado, la Reserva Federal subió las tasas de interés por primera vez en tres años, y los funcionarios del banco central siguen indicando que es necesario tomar más medidas para combatir la inflación. Ver más: ¿Qué pasa con mi dinero si invierto US$100 en el S&P 500? Así se reparte cada dólar El jueves, el gobernador de la Fed, Christopher Waller, afirmó que probablemente serán necesarias nuevas subidas, aunque los funcionarios tienen cierta flexibilidad en cuanto al momento de implementarlas. De manera similar, el presidente del Banco de la Reserva Federal de San Luis, Alberto Musalem, declaró que las tasas deberían subir en los próximos seis a nueve meses, pero no llegó a respaldar la medida en la reunión de política monetaria de este mes. “Dado que los bonos globales y el sentimiento de riesgo siguen pareciendo frágiles, y que la postura restrictiva de la Reserva Federal mantiene a los mercados convencidos de una subida de tasas en diciembre, mantenemos nuestra preferencia por un dólar ligeramente más fuerte a corto plazo”, escribió Francesco Pesole, estratega de divisas de ING Groep NV, en una nota. Sin embargo, la racha alcista del dólar podría verse truncada por la preocupación que suscitan el gasto en inteligencia artificial y las elecciones de mitad de mandato en Estados Unidos que se celebrarán en noviembre. Hasta ahora, el dólar se ha beneficiado del auge de la IA y del posterior repunte récord de las acciones estadounidenses, que han atraído inversión extranjera. El jueves, las acciones cayeron después de que OpenAI informara de unos ingresos inferiores a las estimaciones recientes. Los inversores también están preocupados por los resultados electorales , que determinarán la composición del Congreso para los dos últimos años del mandato del presidente Donald Trump. Ver más: Donald Trump cierra la convención republicana entre dudas sobre las elecciones de medio mandato Las encuestas indican que el Partido Demócrata podría obtener al menos la mayoría en una de las cámaras del Congreso, lo que le daría el control para proponer leyes. Algunos estrategas de Wall Street se están preparando para una posible presión de los demócratas a favor de una regulación más estricta de la IA, lo que podría provocar una caída del mercado . “El riesgo de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato es que el dólar empiece a perder algo de brillo”, afirmó Dominic Bunning, jefe de estrategia de divisas del G10 en Nomura. “Existe el riesgo de que Trump intente reducir la tensión con Irán en las semanas previas a la votación, obteniendo un respiro en los precios de la energía para impulsar las posibilidades de los republicanos”. Trump declaró el jueves que Estados Unidos no atacaría a Irán antes de las elecciones de noviembre, después de haber dicho a principios de este mes que un aumento de los ataques militares contra Irán era “posible” tras las elecciones. Ver más: Donald Trump dice que EE.UU. no atacará a Irán antes de las elecciones de noviembre Por ahora, los operadores especulativos han reforzado su postura alcista sobre el dólar en la semana que finalizó el 29 de septiembre, mostrando una visión más positiva sobre la divisa por segunda semana consecutiva, según muestran los datos de la Comisión de Comercio de Futuros de Productos Básicos (CFTC). “Soy optimista, al menos a corto plazo, ya que el dinero sigue fluyendo hacia Estados Unidos debido a la solidez del sector de inversión en inteligencia artificial, lo que está generando una mayor inflación y un mayor crecimiento nominal”, afirmó Brent Donnelly, presidente de Spectra Markets. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

TURIN, Oct 9 : Stellantis CEO Antonio Filosa said on Friday the automaker's partnership with British startup Wayve could help slash development times and costs for advanced driver-assistance systems as carmakers race to bring autonomous features to market.
Speaking alongside Wayve CEO Alex Kendall at the Wave technology event in Turin, Filosa said scale would be crucial to making hands-free driving affordable and accelerating adoption.
"So as long as penetration follows the path that we believe is going to happen massively ... automotive scale, which is one of the complimentary assets that we bring to Alex, for instance, will decrease costs, which is very important, obviously," Filosa said, referring to so-called level 2++ driving assistance technology, which allows for hands-off driving while still requiring driver supervision.
Reducing development timelines, currently around 24 months for Stellantis, was a key benefit of working with technology partners, he said.

Stellantis in May announced a partnership with Wayve to integrate the startup's AI-powered driving software into its STLA AutoDrive platform. Its first product launch is targeted for 2028 in North America.
European regulators are still working to harmonise approval rules for increasingly sophisticated assisted-driving systems as automakers push for wider deployment.
INTENSIFYING COMPETITION
Traditional automakers initially aimed to develop advanced self-driving systems largely in-house, but with costs soaring and returns taking longer then expected, they are increasingly relying on specialist technology firms.
Wayve is also working with other automakers, including Nissan and Mercedes, and has said its technology is designed to be deployed across multiple vehicle brands and markets.
Kendall said Stellantis' portfolio of brands - which include Jeep, Fiat, Peugeot and Maserati - offered a unique opportunity to tailor autonomous driving characteristics across different vehicles while using the same underlying AI system.
"One of the goals ... is the diversity of vehicles and brands that Stellantis have," he said.
The partnership comes amid intensifying competition in automated driving. Tesla is pushing regulators across Europe to approve its Full Self-Driving technology, arguing advanced driver-assistance systems can improve road safety and accelerate adoption of autonomous features.
At the Turin event, Stellantis and Wayve demonstrated hands-free driving in Fiat 500e and Maserati Grecale development vehicles, extending technology first shown on a Jeep Grand Cherokee earlier this year.

Kendall said Stellantis' portfolio of brands - which include Jeep, Fiat, Peugeot and Maserati - offered a unique opportunity to tailor autonomous driving characteristics across different vehicles while using the same underlying AI system.
"One of the goals ... is the diversity of vehicles and brands that Stellantis have," he said.
The partnership comes amid intensifying competition in automated driving. Tesla is pushing regulators across Europe to approve its Full Self-Driving technology, arguing advanced driver-assistance systems can improve road safety and accelerate adoption of autonomous features.
At the Turin event, Stellantis and Wayve demonstrated hands-free driving in Fiat 500e and Maserati Grecale development vehicles, extending technology first shown on a Jeep Grand Cherokee earlier this year.

items.title: India's Jio Platforms targets $106 billion valuation in IPO, sources say
items.author: Vibhuti Sharma, Kane Wu, Vivek M
items.creator: Vibhuti Sharma, Kane Wu, Vivek M
items.summary: Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Jio Platforms is targeting a valuation of 10.3 trillion rupees ($106 billion) in what would be the country's biggest listing, four bankers on the deal said on Friday.
items.body:
Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Jio Platforms is targeting a valuation of 10.3 trillion rupees ($106 billion) in what would be the country's biggest [USN:L4N45R0BH TEXT:"listing"], four bankers on the deal said on Friday.
Jio Platforms, which counts Meta (META.O) and Google among its major foreign investors, is set to price its shares at 1,065 to 1,119 rupees apiece, the sources told Reuters.
The IPO would raise about 302 billion rupees ($3.1 billion) at the upper end of the price band, surpassing Hyundai Motor India's (HYUN.NS) $2.9 billion issue in 2024.
The sources were not authorised to speak to media and declined to be named. Reliance did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Bloomberg reported the details of the IPO price band and valuations earlier in the day.
Jio's IPO follows the high-profile listing of the [USN:L4N45G0A8 TEXT:"National Stock Exchange of India"] (NSEI.BO) in September, underscoring investor appetite for large offerings in the Indian market.
Year-to-date IPO proceeds in India rose 8.3% to $12.65 billion compared with the same period last year, LSEG data shows.
A successful listing would place Jio Platforms among the top four Indian listed companies by market capitalisation, behind parent Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) , rival Bharti Airtel (BRTI.NS) and the country's largest private lender HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) .
The IPO valuation is below the $131 billion expected in [USN:L1N42R0B2 TEXT:"June"] when the draft papers for the offering were filed. Analysts said the lower IPO pricing was likely due to a broader correction in the secondary market driven by an Iran war-related spike in crude oil prices.
India's benchmark stock index Nifty 50 (.NSEI) has dropped around 6% in nearly four months since then.
Jio, led by Mukesh Ambani's son Akash Ambani, operates Reliance's telecom and digital businesses, spanning mobile services, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise technology and AI offerings.
The company plans to use up to 275 billion rupees of the net proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings of its telecom subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm.
The company's telecom arm had 524.4 million customers as of March. Revenue from operations rose 14.6% to 1.47 trillion rupees in the fiscal year ended March, while profit increased 15.1% to 300.5 billion rupees.
($1 = 96.7300 Indian rupees)

[北京／上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国証券監督管理委員会（ＣＳＲＣ）は９日、株式投資信託の設立要件を緩和する規則案を公表した。中国の主要株価指数が１年超ぶりの安値に迫る中での措置となる。

ＣＳＲＣは声明で、規則改定は株式投信の発展を支援し、より多くの長期資金を株式市場に誘導することが目的と説明した。

規則案によると、株式投信の設立に必要な募集額を、現在の２億元から５０００万元（７４７万ドル）に引き下げる。

他の投資信託に投資するファンド・オブ・ファンズ（ＦＯＦ）にも要件緩和を適用する。一方、債券に投資する投信の要件は据え置く。

主要銘柄で構成するＣＳＩ３００指数は９日、人工知能（ＡＩ）サプライチェーン関連株の売りが一段と強まり、１年ぶりの安値に近い水準で引けた。

items.title: US-based Kalitta Air orders Airbus freighter jets, sources say
items.author: Tim Hepher, Dan Catchpole, Allison Lampert
items.creator: Tim Hepher, Dan Catchpole, Allison Lampert
items.summary: US military and commercial freight contractor Kalitta Air has ordered eight Airbus A350F freighters as it looks beyond long-time supplier Boeing to tap European capacity for the first time, three people familiar with the order said.
items.body:
US military and commercial freight contractor Kalitta Air has ordered eight Airbus (AIR.PA) A350F freighters as it looks beyond long-time supplier Boeing (BA.N) to tap European capacity for the first time, three people familiar with the order said.
Airbus, which declined to comment on any commercial discussions, posted the deal as a firm contract in a recent orders update without identifying the buyer, the people said.
Michigan-based Kalitta Air said it was evaluating the jet but had yet to make a decision.
"Kalitta Air is evaluating the Airbus A350F platform as part of our long-term fleet planning," an airline spokesperson said.
"At this time, we remain in the evaluation phase and have no aircraft order to announce."
Founded in 2000 by drag-racing legend Conrad "Connie" Kalitta, the airline traces its roots to a business he set up in 1967 to transport car parts in his own self-piloted Cessna.
It now has a fleet of more than two dozen Boeing 747 and 777 freighters working scheduled and one-off cargo charter flights for customers including the Pentagon and US Postal Service.
Long dominated by Boeing, the market for air freighters is heating up after Airbus launched the A350F to challenge the out-of-production Boeing 747 and two versions of the Boeing 777.
Airbus data shows an order for eight freighters on August 31 without identifying the buyer. That is a common practice whenever airlines want to shield their expansion plans from rivals for as long as possible.
One of the people said an airline's decision to expand its fleet could typically be used as a bargaining chip in pilot negotiations, meaning there was no incentive to make it public.
A spokesperson for the Air Line Pilots Association, which represents Kalitta Air pilots, said its members had been in negotiations with the carrier's management since late 2024.

Oct 9 : Italy's Sofia Goggia will miss the season-opening race in Soelden, Austria, on October 24 as she continues to recover from a viral infection, she told Italian news agency ANSA on Friday.
The 2018 Olympic gold medallist said at an event in Milan that she did not yet know how long a full recovery would take.
"It could be anything from 10 days to a month and a half," she was quoted as saying by ANSA.
Goggia is the second Italian alpine skiing star to say she will miss Soelden, joining Olympic champion Federica Brignone, who is still recovering from a leg injury.
Speaking at the same event, Brignone said she wanted to return to skiing, but "only when I feel better," ANSA reported. She gave no indication of when that might be.

items.title: EU aviation body widens Saudi airspace warning after Houthi strikes
items.author: Gianluca Lo Nostro
items.creator: Gianluca Lo Nostro
items.summary: Europe's EASA aviation safety body said on Friday it had expanded the area of Saudi Arabian airspace where it recommended airlines not to operate, after Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis attacked Riyadh airport.
items.body:
Europe's EASA aviation safety body said on Friday it had expanded the area of Saudi Arabian airspace where it recommended airlines not to operate, after Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis [USN:L1N45U0A3 TEXT:"attacked Riyadh airport"].
In an update to a conflict zone information bulletin [USN:L1N45M0PB TEXT:"first issued"] on September 30, the EU regulator said recent attacks demonstrated the Houthis' ability and intent to strike targets deeper inside Saudi territory, including the capital. EASA added an area in northwestern Saudi Arabia to the advisory.
Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority said earlier on Friday that [USN:L1N45V06F TEXT:"three Saudi nationals"] were killed and several people were injured in two attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Thursday.
The Houthis have renewed threats against airlines flying to Saudi Arabia and said on Thursday they had struck the capital's airport with two cruise missiles.
"These recurrent missile and drone attacks, together with the activation of air-defence systems, create an increased risk of misidentification of civil aircraft, as well as risks associated with missile and drone overflights, interception activity and falling debris," EASA said.
OPSGROUP, a membership-based organisation with almost 10,000 aviation professionals that shares flight risk information, sent a "do not fly" warning for Saudi Arabia to its members on Friday, citing risks of sustained missile attacks and "misjudgment" in defensive responses.
"We now recommend avoiding operations in Saudi Arabia entirely, including the use of Saudi airports as en route alternates," it said in the memo shared with Reuters.
LUFTHANSA, INDIAN AIRLINES SUSPEND FLIGHTS Following Thursday's attacks, Lufthansa Group and three Indian airlines said they would [USN:L6N45U10R TEXT:"suspend flights"] to Riyadh expected in the coming days.
King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh is Saudi Arabia's second-busiest airport after Jeddah. It handled 296,800 flights in 2025, equivalent to about 813 a day, according to Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics.
Global flight tracker FlightRadar24 showed 131 flights to and from Riyadh had been cancelled by 1305 GMT on Friday after hundreds of cancellations the previous day.

items.title: Lessor Avolon orders 250 Boeing, Airbus jets with option for 100 more
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Global leasing giant Avolon said on Friday it had agreed to order 140 aircraft from Boeing and 110 from Airbus , with an option to buy a further 100 jets from the European planemaker.
items.body:
Global leasing giant Avolon said on Friday it had agreed to order 140 aircraft from Boeing (BA.N) and 110 from Airbus (AIR.PA) , with an option to buy a further 100 jets from the European planemaker.
The orders were the largest Avolon, the world's third-biggest aircraft lessor, has placed with either manufacturer and bring its total number of aircraft on order to 749, on top of the 561 it currently owns.
Dublin-based Avolon said the order comprised 140 Boeing 737 MAX jets, 75 Airbus A320neo planes and 35 of its wide-body A330neos, with options for a further 100 unspecified Airbus aircraft.
Aircraft lessors own around half the world's airline fleet and have been in hot demand from airlines in recent years due to a backlog of plane orders, a trend that has supported the specialist industry's rentals, resale values and profits.
It has also allowed leading lessors like Avolon to sell their older planes to make room for more fuel-efficient new-technology aircraft.
Avolon said in a trading update on Friday that it had sold 29 aircraft during the July-September quarter, with a further 112 aircraft agreed for sale at the end of September.
"We continue to see strong demand for new-technology aircraft, reflected in our placement and trading activity this quarter," Avolon CEO Andy Cronin said in a statement.
The new orders are subject to approval by Avolon's majority shareholder, China's Bohai Leasing Co Ltd (000415.SZ) , which the lessor said is expected before the end of this month.

items.title: ロシア・ヤンデックス、ウクライナの攻撃でデータセンター一部停止
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[９日 ロイター] - ウクライナは９日、ロシアのＩＴ企業ヤンデックスが運営するデータセンターを攻撃し、一部を稼働不能にした。

ヤンデックスはロシアの人工知能（ＡＩ）開発に深く関わり、「ロシアのグーグル」と呼ばれることもある。同社によると、モスクワ南西のカルーガ州にあるデータセンターがウクライナの無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受け、一部が稼働を停止した。

前日の８日には、リャザン州サソボにある同社の主要データセンターがウクライナの攻撃で停止した。同施設には、同社のＡＩモデルの開発に使うスーパーコンピューター３基のうち２基が設置されている。ヤンデックスは被害状況を調べており、設備が復旧可能かどうかは確認できないとしている。

Ｔインベストメンツの株式調査責任者マリャナ・ラザリチェワ氏は「リスクはヤンデックスのサービスが一時的に利用できなくなる可能性や、特定部門の減収にとどまらない。幅広い法人顧客基盤にも及ぶ」と指摘した。

攻撃による障害の全容は明らかになっていない。ただ少なくともヤンデックスのアプリの１つに、動作に問題が生じる可能性を知らせるメッセージが表示された。

ヤンデックスは声明で、障害が発生したサービスの復旧に向け、２４時間態勢で作業していると説明した。「現在これが最重要課題だが、残念ながら容易ではない」と述べた。
