items.title: Blindness treatment based on Nobel-winning research shows promise
items.author: Nancy Lapid
items.creator: Nancy Lapid
items.summary: It's Nobel Prize season and today we feature promising early results of a novel technique for treating blindness that made Nobel laureates of three scientists this week. We also report on two studies comparing treatment options presented at the American Society for Radiation Oncology meeting.
items.body:
It's Nobel Prize season and today we feature promising early results of a novel technique for treating blindness that made Nobel laureates of three scientists this week. We also report on two studies comparing treatment options presented at the American Society for Radiation Oncology meeting.
NOBEL-WINNING THERAPY SHOWS EARLY PROMISE IN BLIND PATIENTS Patients with blindness due to retinitis pigmentosa who received a treatment based on research that won the 2026 [USN:S8N44O00U TEXT:"Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine"] had their ability to detect objects restored in a small trial that demonstrated the potential of the novel approach.
So-called optogenetic therapy uses light to control brain cells. In the study, researchers combined gene therapy that made surviving retinal ganglion cells sensitive to light with delivery of light to stimulate these cells.
The 10 trial participants each received an injection into one eye carrying genetic instructions for ChrimsonR, a light-sensitive protein from GenSight Biologics (SIGHT.PA) .
Patients then wore goggles that captured visual information, converted it into patterns of light at wavelengths that activated ChrimsonR in the modified retinal cells, and sent the patterns of light back to the eye.
Seven patients became more sensitive to light, with six achieving clinically meaningful improvements, such as being able to detect when an object was present, determine where it was located and reach toward it accurately.
One severe adverse event occurred immediately after injection and resolved within minutes, researchers reported in The New England Journal of Medicine .
While larger studies are needed to definitively prove the usefulness of ChrimsonR and the goggles, the findings show that even at a very advanced stage of blindness, surviving retinal ganglion cells can be made responsive to light and transmit visual information to the brain, the researchers said.
"Even in people with profound vision loss, the visual system retains a remarkable capacity to process new information," study leader Dr. José-Alain Sahel of the University of Pittsburgh said in a statement.
RADIATION EFFECTIVE AS SURGERY FOR LOCALIZED PROSTATE CANCER Radiotherapy kept localized prostate cancer under control just as well as surgery, with fewer side effects, researchers reported at the recent American Society for Radiation Oncology , or ASTRO, meeting in Boston.
After a median of eight years of following patients, survival without recurrence was statistically similar. Of those who received five sessions of stereotactic body radiation therapy delivered over two weeks, 91% were alive without cancer recurrence versus 84% after surgery.
SBRT delivers the radiation directly to the prostate while limiting exposure to nearby healthy tissue.
The trial involved 123 patients, most with low- or intermediate-risk cancers who were monitored for reappearance of a tumor or a rise in prostate-specific antigen levels, a potential indicator of prostate cancer.
The trial’s original goal was to compare quality of life after the interventions. Efforts to enroll nearly twice as many participants were thwarted by the COVID pandemic, leaving the study with too few patients to answer that question.
Because it was not designed to establish noninferiority for cancer control, the trial cannot prove the treatments are equivalent for this outcome.
“What we can say is that... we have mature data showing excellent cancer outcomes with five-treatment radiotherapy,” study leader Dr. Nicholas van As of The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust in the UK said in a statement.
A separate analysis presented at ASTRO found that patient-reported sexual-function scores declined in both groups but remained significantly better after the radiation therapy. Median erectile-function scores on a 25-point scale, where higher scores indicate better function, were 19 with SBRT and 5 for prostatectomy after five years.
Also at five years, 8.3% of SBRT patients were using urinary pads for leaks, compared with 48% of surgery patients.
AVOIDING WHOLE-BRAIN RADIATION IN RARE LUNG CANCER Patients with an uncommon, aggressive form of lung cancer who develop brain metastases can benefit from a safer radiotherapy technique that is already standard for common lung tumors, according to data from a study reported at ASTRO .
Stereotactic radiosurgery uses high-dose radiation beams to destroy brain tumors without surgical incisions and with minimal damage to nearby brain tissues.
It is already the preferred treatment for brain metastases from most other tumors. Small cell lung cancer has been an exception for fear that treating only visible tumors could leave cancer cells behind.
As a result, patients undergo whole-brain radiation, increasing their risks for memory loss and other cognitive declines.
In the trial, 151 patients received either stereotactic radiosurgery or a modern form of whole-brain radiation.
Patients lived a median of 17 months after focused stereotactic radiosurgery versus nine months following whole-brain radiotherapy.
The trial was designed to assess the length of time before patients experienced cognitive decline from each treatment method. The researchers found no significant difference, possibly because of protection afforded by the newer form of whole-brain radiation, they said.
Comparisons of cognitive outcomes may also have been complicated by fewer whole-brain radiation patients alive for later follow-up.
While prolonged survival was not the trial's primary goal and cannot be proved by this study, the results show how far both approaches have come, principal investigator Dr. Vinai Gondi of the Northwestern Medicine West Region and Proton Center in Warrenville, Illinois, said in a statement.
“For patients with small cell lung cancer, we now have two modern radiation therapy strategies to consider and randomized evidence to help us understand how best to use them,” Gondi said.

items.title: IKEA's Danish stores could become shelters as Europe boosts preparedness
items.author: Soren Jeppesen, Agnieszka Olenska
items.creator: Soren Jeppesen, Agnieszka Olenska
items.summary: In the bedding department of Denmark's largest IKEA store, security chief Torben Mortensen walks past rows of display beds and describes a use for them far removed from retail: emergency shelter.
items.body:
In the bedding department of Denmark's largest IKEA store, security chief Torben Mortensen walks past rows of display beds and describes a use for them far removed from retail: emergency shelter.
If a blackout, flood or attack on critical infrastructure struck, IKEA could turn its stores into emergency shelters or even temporary hospitals. Restaurants could provide meals, generators could keep the buildings running and extra beds could be assembled from flat packs pulled from warehouse shelves.
The idea reflects a broader shift in [USN:S8N3P3098 TEXT:"how Europe is thinking"] about security, with governments increasingly looking beyond armed forces and emergency services to businesses that can help keep societies functioning during a crisis.
[USN:L8N45F1L2 TEXT:"A wave of"] suspected sabotage, cyber attacks and other incidents that European officials have linked to Russian hybrid warfare has added urgency to those efforts. Denmark's [USN:L8N45G0M0 TEXT:"intelligence service has warned"] Russia is likely to intensify such activities against NATO countries and other Western states in the coming months, an accusation Moscow denies.
"We want to be the good neighbour. We want to be the company that can support society in case of a crisis," Mortensen said.
The European Union is encouraging member states to work more closely with businesses as part of its Preparedness Union Strategy, launched in March 2025.
IKEA is part of Denmark's Corporate Coalition for Crisis Preparedness, a network that catalogues what private firms can provide in an emergency, from beds and food supplies to trucks and specialist staff.
"IKEA is a very good example because nobody would put them naturally on a list of crisis resources ... An IKEA store has space, goods, food facilities, and generators," said Maja Broloes, CEO of the network.
The concept is not purely theoretical. During [USN:L8N3M90I3 TEXT:"deadly floods"] in Valencia, Spain, in October 2024, IKEA turned one of its stores into a shelter for more than 600 people.
The retailer said it did not have a global preparedness programme and that such arrangements were managed country by country.
BUSINESS AS BACKUP Other Danish retailers are also preparing for emergencies. Salling Group, Denmark's largest supermarket operator, is opening the first of 51 stores designed to operate for up to 48 hours without electricity or internet access.
The trend extends beyond Denmark.
Estonia requires 300 companies by law to maintain critical services during a crisis, while Finland has a network of authorities, NGOs and companies responsible for supply security. In Poland, some companies are required by law to let the armed forces use their vehicles, machinery and property in a crisis.
The Danish network includes more than 200 companies employing more than 300,000 people, from retailers and construction groups to telecoms providers.
"If a crisis hits, the authorities will have one place to ask, and we find companies that can help," Broloes said.
She said a state-backed compensation scheme was being established, with reimbursement determined on a case-by-case basis.
The voluntary network has taken part in preparedness exercises with government authorities but has yet to face a major real-world emergency.
Still, there has already been a glimpse of how a Danish IKEA store might function as a shelter.
In December 2021, a snowstorm trapped six customers and about two dozen employees overnight at an IKEA store in Aalborg, forcing them to sleep in the display beds.
By the next morning, staff had changed the sheets and reopened the store to shoppers.

MANCHESTER, England, Oct 9 : Enzo Maresca mounted an emphatic defence of Manchester City's achievements on Friday, rejecting any suggestion their titles were tainted and insisting the threat of sanctions over financial-rule breaches would not have deterred him from taking the job.
Maresca, who was part of Pep Guardiola's coaching staff when City won the treble in 2022-23, was peppered with questions about the case for almost the entirety of his press conference ahead of Sunday's Premier League clash with Liverpool at Anfield.
It is the league leaders' first game since being found guilty of more than 100 serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules. City have denied all wrongdoing and are appealing.
"The last time I was here was the treble season (2022-23)," he added. "I know the effort from the players, from the club, from the manager in that time, that was Pep. So I know exactly the effort that the club put to achieve that kind of target. So I don't have any doubt about that."

Asked directly whether those achievements felt tainted, the Italian replied: "Absolutely not."
The Italian, who was hired to replace Guardiola in June, also repeatedly stressed his faith in City's ownership, and said the topic of the club's charges was never raised during his managerial contract negotiations.
"I trust the club because I trust the people. So that is why I joined the club," Maresca said. "And then there is not another club where I would like to be. So I'm very happy to be here, I'm very proud since day one."
MARESCA BACKS CITY
Maresca said he would "absolutely" still have taken the job had he known exactly what lay ahead, and turned the tables several times when the prospect of City losing their appeal was raised.
"But what will we do if Manchester City win?" he said.
Guardiola famously commented in May 2022 that he would walk away from the club if he discovered they had lied to him.
Maresca was asked if he felt the same.
"I would like to speak about this situation when we win the appeal," he said. "Now is no sense to speak about anything because I don't have many information, but I understand the reason why most of you are here, because most of you want to hear something. But no."
Guardiola had also joked about coaching City in League One after the Premier League's 115 financial allegations were levelled against the club in 2023.
Asked if he would remain City's manager regardless of any potential sanctions, Maresca lightened the mood by pointing to his record at Leicester City.
"I won the Championship with Leicester, so if we go down to League One, we will see," he said.
After nearly 15 minutes dominated by the case, Maresca greeted the first question about football, concerning Erling Haaland's fitness following the international break, with a smile: "Finally."
ANFIELD SECURITY CONCERNS
City now turn their attention to Liverpool and a trip to Anfield.
Merseyside police have said an appropriate policing operation will be in place with security under scrutiny amid concerns City's team bus could be targeted.
A social media post promoting a "Bus greeting" has urged Liverpool supporters to gather near the stadium several hours before kickoff with flags, banners, pyrotechnics and flares.
"I'm always concerned (ahead of games), not just Liverpool, I will also be concerned about Ipswich," Maresca said. "I know that Anfield is a nice pitch, probably will be even more warm in terms of environment, but the reason I decide to become manager is for this kind of game."
City's team bus was struck by bottles, cans and flares before a Champions League match at Anfield in 2018 and was damaged badly enough that a replacement was required for the journey back to Manchester.

items.title: Ex-Deutsche Bank top trader's rate-rigging conviction quashed
items.author: Kirstin Ridley
items.creator: Kirstin Ridley
items.summary: Christian Bittar, a former star Deutsche Bank trader jailed in Britain for conspiring to rig benchmark interest rates, won an appeal to clear his name on Friday, in a fresh blow to the Serious Fraud Office prosecutor.
items.body:
Christian Bittar, a former star Deutsche Bank (DBKGn.DE) trader jailed in Britain for conspiring to rig benchmark interest rates, won an appeal to clear his name on Friday, in a fresh blow to the Serious Fraud Office prosecutor.
Bittar was sentenced to five years and four months after pleading guilty in 2018 to conspiring to manipulate Euribor, the Euro Interbank Offered Rate, which helps determine rates on trillions of dollars of financial contracts and loans worldwide.
But London's Court of Appeal on Friday quashed the conviction, bringing to six the number of SFO rate-rigging convictions overturned this week alone because of legal errors. Judges will publish their written reasons later.
"I have waited a very, very long time for this day," Bittar said in a statement. "Finally, the injustice of what I and others suffered has been recognised. I am so grateful for those who stood by me through this ordeal and those who worked so tirelessly to correct it."
Jason Williams, the head of division at the SFO, said the investigator and prosecutor had argued for a different outcome but respected the court's decision.
"The SFO remains committed to tackling the most complex fraud, bribery and corruption," he added.
BARCLAYS FIVE SEE CONVICTIONS QUASHED Bittar's appeal was heard after senior judges on Wednesday [USN:L8N45T0X8 TEXT:"overturned"] the convictions of five former Barclays (BARC.L) traders, further [USN:L8N3TK0IL TEXT:"unspooling"] some of the SFO's most high-profile prosecutions.
Bittar, who earned tens of millions of pounds at Deutsche Bank, is the first person convicted of either manipulating Euribor or Libor, its now-defunct London counterpart, to have seen his conviction overturned following a guilty plea.
But his lawyer, Adrian Darbishire, argued that his client's guilty plea was founded on fundamental errors of law, because prosecutors had not been required to prove a factual element of the charge against him - that he had agreed to the submission of "false or misleading" Euribor rates.
The derivatives traders were cast by prosecutors as a symbol of banker greed at a time of taxpayer fury at eye-watering bank bailouts following the 2007-2009 credit crisis, which sent stock markets plunging and pitched economies into recession.
Launching a criminal investigation in 2012, the SFO prosecuted 20 people. Seven were convicted at trial, two pleaded guilty and 11 were acquitted during a series of tricky London rate-rigging trials and re-trials between 2015 and 2019.
Eight of those convictions have now been overturned after the Supreme Court last year [USN:L8N3TK0IL TEXT:"ruled"] that legal errors had undermined the fairness of the first Libor trial - that of former UBS (UBSG.S) and Citigroup (C.N) trader Tom Hayes and a later trial of former Barclays peer, Carlo Palombo.
Those errors, which centred on how judges directed the juries, also tarnished later rate-rigging trials, the Court of Appeal ruled on Wednesday.

[シカゴ ９日 ロイター] - 米デルタ航空は９日、通期の利益予想を中央値で約２５％引き下げた。旅行需要は堅調で航空券価格も上昇したが、燃料費の急増を補い切れなかった。

デルタは年間燃料費が前年より約６０億ドル増えると見込む。第３・四半期の燃料費は前年同期比６２％増の４１億ドルとなり、７月時点の想定を５億ドル超上回った。

エリック・スネル最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は記者団から利益予想引き下げの理由を問われ、「燃料が全てだ」と述べた。夏以降、原油と精製後のジェット燃料の両方が値上がりしたと指摘した。

通期の調整後１株利益予想は５．１０─５．６０ドルとし、７月時点の６．５０─７．５０ドルから引き下げた。新たな中央値の５．３５ドルは、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５．４６ドルを下回る。２０２６年の調整後税引き前利益は４５億ドルを見込む。

第３・四半期決算は、調整後１株利益が１．７２ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１．７６ドルをわずかに下回った。調整後営業利益率は１１．１％から９．４％に低下した。

デルタは需要が引き続き堅調だとしている。スネル氏によると、第４・四半期分は既に６０％近くが予約済みで、売上高は前年同期比約２０％増を見込む。

第４・四半期の調整後１株利益は１．１５─１．６５ドルを見込む。中央値の１．４０ドルは、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の１．３９ドルとほぼ一致した。

items.title: Humana surges after topping 2027 Medicare star ratings
items.author: Christy Santhosh
items.creator: Christy Santhosh
items.summary: Humana's shares rose 15% on Friday after analysts named it the top beneficiary of the new star ratings for 2027 Medicare Advantage plans, marking a sharp turnaround for the health insurer.
items.body:
Humana's (HUM.N) shares rose 15% on Friday after analysts named it the top beneficiary of the new star ratings for 2027 Medicare Advantage plans, marking a sharp turnaround for the health insurer.
Humana said 95% of its Medicare Advantage members will be enrolled in plans rated four stars or higher in 2027, up from just [USN:L3N3VQ1HW TEXT:"20% in 2026"], and above J.P. Morgan's expectations of 60% to 70%.
Higher ratings from the US health department net insurers billions of dollars in bonus payments from the government.
Analysts said Humana's ratings outshine those of larger rivals: J.P. Morgan estimates UnitedHealth's (UNH.N) share of enrollments in plans rated four stars or higher will fall to about 67% from 81% and that of CVS Health (CVS.N) to roughly 70% from 84%.
POOR RATINGS IN 2025 AND 2026 Humana had been under pressure since a steep drop in its 2025 ratings threatened its bonus payments. The insurer [USN:L6N3VV0WJ TEXT:"lost a lawsuit"] challenging how the 2025 ratings were calculated in October last year, and forecast 2026 profit [USN:L4N3Z70UI TEXT:"below Wall Street estimates"] in February.
Evercore ISI analyst Elizabeth Anderson attributed the sharp rise to improvements in measures of drug-plan quality, health-plan quality and readmissions. The insurer could receive $4.8 billion in bonus payments in 2028 as a result, she said.
Baird analysts said the boost to profits will depend on reinvestment in member benefits and arrangements with healthcare providers.
Humana is one of the largest providers of Medicare Advantage plans serving people aged 65 and older as well as people with disabilities.
Overall, [USN:L4N45U1QK TEXT:"about 71%"] of Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan enrollees are in contracts that will be rated four stars or higher in 2027, the health department said late on Thursday.
items.raw_description: Humana's shares rose 15% on Friday after analysts named it the top beneficiary of the new star ratings for 2027 Medicare Advantage plans, marking a sharp turnaround for the health insurer.

items.title: China se compromete a frenar burbujas tecnológicas y controlar riesgos de la IA
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China reforzará la supervisión de su apuesta por la tecnología avanzada, con el objetivo de frenar las burbujas de inversión y garantizar al mismo tiempo que la inteligencia artificial sea "segura, fiable y controlable", según las directrices políticas publicadas el viernes.
items.body:
China reforzará la supervisión de su apuesta por la tecnología avanzada, con el objetivo de frenar las burbujas de inversión y garantizar al mismo tiempo que la inteligencia artificial sea "segura, fiable y controlable", según las directrices políticas publicadas el viernes.
Mientras Pekín intensifica su apoyo a la fabricación de alta tecnología y las industrias estratégicas para impulsar la autosuficiencia tecnológica en medio de la rivalidad con Estados Unidos, las directrices advirtieron contra la inversión a ciegas y la expansión excesiva en sectores emergentes.
"El desarrollo de nuevas fuerzas productivas es un requisito inherente y un eje importante para promover un desarrollo de alta calidad", según citó la agencia estatal de noticias Xinhua sobre las directrices, publicadas por el Partido Comunista y el Gobierno.
El presidente Xi Jinping introdujo el término "nuevas fuerzas productivas" en 2023, haciendo hincapié en la investigación científica, los avances tecnológicos y la modernización industrial en toda la base manufacturera de China.
Las directrices indicaron que China buscará avances en la teoría y las tecnologías fundamentales de la IA, reforzará la oferta de potencia de cálculo, algoritmos y datos, y establecerá bases piloto nacionales para aplicaciones industriales de la IA.
También abogan por sistemas de seguimiento tecnológico, alerta de riesgos y respuesta ante emergencias para garantizar que la IA siga siendo "segura, fiable y controlable".
China aplicará plenamente su iniciativa "IA Plus" para modernizar las industrias tradicionales y acelerar el despliegue de productos inteligentes, incluidos los vehículos conectados de nueva energía, los teléfonos y ordenadores con IA, y los robots humanoides, según el documento.
Las directrices también se comprometieron a reforzar la innovación "original y disruptiva" en tecnologías clave y a utilizar el "nuevo sistema nacional" impulsado por el Estado chino para acelerar el desarrollo y el despliegue de productos emblemáticos.
Al mismo tiempo, se indicó a los funcionarios que den prioridad a la economía real y eviten las burbujas, el vaciamiento industrial, la inversión a ciegas y las carreras "en masa" hacia los sectores de alta tecnología.
China "prohibirá estrictamente el abuso ilegal o indebido de las políticas en nombre del desarrollo de nuevas fuerzas productivas", señalaron las directrices, añadiendo que los funcionarios responsables de pérdidas importantes causadas por inversiones a ciegas tendrán que rendir cuentas.
El documento también defiende un desarrollo saludable y ordenado de la "economía de baja altitud" —empresas basadas en drones civiles, taxis aéreos, aeronaves pequeñas y servicios relacionados— garantizando al mismo tiempo la seguridad.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ ９日 ロイター] - ロイターが入手した書簡によると、パレスチナのシェイフ副大統領はフランスに対し、パレスチナ領域全体で情勢が悪化していることを理由に、１１月２８日に予定されていた評議会（議会）選を数カ月延期すると伝えた。

８日付のバロ仏外相宛て書簡は「日程設定の根拠として見込んでいた政治的、治安的、経済的状況が実現していないとの評価に達した」と説明。「現在の状況下で選挙を実施することは、その包摂性、参加の自由、選挙プロセスの公正性に影響を及ぼす根本的な障害に直面する」と付け加えている。

items.title: China vows to curb tech bubbles, keep AI risks in check
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China will tighten oversight of its drive into advanced technology, seeking to curb investment bubbles while ensuring artificial intelligence remains "safe, reliable and controllable", according to policy guidelines issued on Friday.
items.body:
China will tighten oversight of its drive into advanced technology, seeking to curb investment bubbles while ensuring artificial intelligence remains "safe, reliable and controllable", according to policy guidelines issued on Friday.
As Beijing ramps up support for high-tech manufacturing and strategic industries to boost technological self-sufficiency amid rivalry with the US, the guidelines warned against blind investment and excessive expansion into emerging sectors.
"Developing new productive forces is an inherent requirement and an important focus for promoting high-quality development," Xinhua cited the guidelines, issued by the ruling Communist Party and the cabinet, as saying.
President Xi Jinping introduced the term "new productive forces" in 2023, emphasising scientific research, technological breakthroughs and industrial upgrading across China's manufacturing base.
The guidelines said China would seek breakthroughs in AI theory and core technologies, strengthen the supply of computing power, algorithms and data, and establish national pilot bases for industrial AI applications. They also called for technology monitoring, risk-warning and emergency-response systems to ensure AI remains "safe, reliable and controllable".
China will fully implement its "AI Plus" initiative, using AI to upgrade traditional industries and accelerate the rollout of intelligent products including connected new-energy vehicles, AI-enabled phones and computers, and humanoid robots, the document said.
The guidelines also pledged to strengthen "original and disruptive" innovation in core technologies and to use China's state-led "new nationwide system" to speed the development and deployment of landmark products.
At the same time, officials were told to prioritise the real economy and avoid bubbles, industrial hollowing-out, blind investment and "swarm-like" rushes into high-tech sectors.
China will "strictly prohibit the illegal or improper abuse of policies in the name of developing new productive forces," the guidelines said, adding that officials responsible for major losses caused by blind investment would be held accountable.
The document also called for the healthy and orderly development of the low-altitude economy — businesses built around civilian drones, air taxis, small aircraft and related services — while ensuring safety.

items.title: Two men deny carrying out surveillance for Iran of Israeli embassy in UK
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two Iranian nationals accused of being tasked by Iran to carry out hostile surveillance on the Israeli Embassy in London, Britain's oldest synagogue and other Israeli or Jewish targets pleaded not guilty on Friday.
items.body:
Two Iranian nationals accused of being tasked by Iran to carry out hostile surveillance on the Israeli Embassy in London, Britain's oldest synagogue and other Israeli or Jewish targets pleaded not guilty on Friday.
Nematollah Shahsavani, 41, and Alireza Farasati, 22, appeared at London's Old Bailey court and denied a single offence under the National Security Act. They were remanded in custody ahead of their trial, which is due to begin in April.
The pair are among several individuals who have been charged in separate cases with acting on behalf of Iran in Britain.
Britain has recently accused Iran of being behind a [USN:L1N45O076 TEXT:"suspected plot"] targeting the US-linked RAF Fairford military base, with seven men arrested and then [USN:L8N45U0PF TEXT:"released on bail"].
Iran has denied any involvement in hostile activity in Britain, including the alleged RAF Fairford plot, after which the [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"US removed its B-1 bombers"] from the base.
Shahsavani, a dual Iranian-British national, and Iranian national Farasati are alleged to have gathered information and undertaken reconnaissance in July and August 2025 on behalf of the Iranian intelligence services.
Their list of alleged targets included the Israeli Embassy, the Israeli Consulate and London's Bevis Marks Synagogue. Judge Bobbie Cheema-Grubb said one alleged target also included an unnamed individual "of intelligence interest" to Iran.
After they were [USN:L1N40709F TEXT:"charged in March"], Britain's Foreign Office said it had [USN:L8N40B1X1 TEXT:"summoned Iran's ambassador"] to the UK.

items.title: インド株式市場・引け＝反発、原油高止まりを依然懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Bharath Rajeswaran　Vivek Kumar M

[９日 ロイター] - インド株式市場は反発し、２５年ぶりの長さとなった週間での下落が途切れた。ただ、金融引き締めや原油価格の高止まりへの懸念が重しとなり、上昇幅は小幅にとどまった。

ＮＳＥ指数は１．３％高の２万２５２０．４５、ＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は１．２３％高の７万２４７２．３３で終了した。業界大手タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）の決算で、ＡＩ関連収益の寄与拡大と堅調な海外事業の成長が示されたことを受け、ＩＴ株が相場を主導した。

ＮＳＥ指数とＳＥＮＳＥＸ指数は週間でそれぞれ０．４％高、０．８％高となった。直近８週間ではそれぞれ８．７％、８．４％下落していた。

チョラマンダラム証券の株式調査責任者、ダルメシュ・カント氏は、「直近の下げで市場はテクニカル面で引き続き支えられるはずだ。企業の増益が期待通りに持続し、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドルを下回る水準まで下落すれば、ＮＳＥ指数は約５％上昇する可能性がある」と述べた。

items.title: Flávio tem 51,1% e Lula 45,7% das intenções de voto no 2º turno, mostra Atlas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lidera o segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), rompendo o empate técnico apontado em simulações feitas em levantamentos anteriores, mostrou pesquisa Atlas/Bloomberg divulgada nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
O senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lidera o segundo turno da eleição presidencial contra o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), rompendo o empate técnico apontado em simulações feitas em levantamentos anteriores, mostrou pesquisa Atlas/Bloomberg divulgada nesta sexta-feira.
De acordo com a pesquisa, Flávio registra 51,1% das intenções de voto para o segundo turno, ante 47,4% da pesquisa anterior, enquanto Lula aparece com 45,7%, ante 47,6%.
O percentual de eleitores indecisos ou que pretendem votar em branco ou anular o voto caiu para 3,2%, de 5,0% na pesquisa anterior.
A margem de erro da pesquisa é de 1 ponto percentual para mais ou para menos.
Para a pesquisa, contratada pela Bloomberg, o instituto AtlasIntel ouviu 5.026 pessoas online entre os dias 3 e 8 de outubro.
Flávio Bolsonaro terminou o primeiro turno da eleição presidencial no último domingo na liderança com 47,03%, contrariando o que apontavam os principais institutos de pesquisa, enquanto Lula obteve 45,16% dos votos.

items.title: Delta Air slashes profit forecast as $6 billion fuel-cost surge outstrips fare gains
items.author: Rajesh Singh
items.creator: Rajesh Singh
items.summary: Delta Air Lines cut its annual profit forecast by nearly a quarter on Friday as soaring fuel costs, expected to add $6 billion to its bill in 2026, overwhelmed resilient travel demand and higher ticket prices.
items.body:
Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) cut its annual profit forecast by nearly a quarter on Friday as soaring fuel costs, expected to add $6 billion to its bill in 2026, overwhelmed resilient travel demand and higher ticket prices.
Its shares fell 2.5% in early trading after the carrier cut its 2026 profit forecast for the first time this year and lifted its projected fuel-cost increase by $2 billion as the Iran war has driven jet fuel prices sharply higher worldwide. With no end to the war in sight, carriers are confronting their worst crisis since the pandemic.
The downgrade underscores a growing challenge for the industry: whether passengers will absorb further fare increases if fuel prices remain elevated. Airlines have already raised fares substantially this year and analysts warn further increases could test travelers' willingness to keep spending.
Delta, the first major global carrier to report third-quarter results, said fuel expenses for the period rose 62% from a year earlier to $4.1 billion, exceeding its July forecast by more than $500 million.
"All of it's fuel," Delta Chief Financial Officer Erik Snell told reporters when asked what drove the forecast cut, citing increases in both crude oil and refined jet fuel prices since the summer.
Delta now expects adjusted annual earnings of $5.10 to $5.60 a share, down from the $6.50 to $7.50 per share it forecast in July. The new midpoint of $5.35 per share is below analysts' average estimate of $5.46 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG. It forecast $4.5 billion in adjusted pre-tax profit for 2026.
Third-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.72 a share narrowly missed analysts' average estimate of $1.76 apiece, according to data compiled by LSEG. Its adjusted operating margin fell to 9.4% from 11.1%.
Rivals United Airlines (UAL.O) , American Airlines (AAL.O) and Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) are due to report later this month. Ryanair Group (RYA.I) CEO Michael O'Leary [USN:L6N45U0JC TEXT:"warned"] on Thursday that European airlines could face more than another year of elevated fuel costs due to the war.
HIGHER FARES US airlines spent $42.9 billion on fuel for scheduled flights in the first eight months of 2026, nearly $13.2 billion more than a year earlier, despite using slightly less fuel, according to the Bureau of Transportation Statistics.
Strong demand and limited growth in seats have helped carriers pass higher fuel costs on to passengers. US airline fares rose an average of about 25% from a year earlier in the five months through August, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' consumer price index.
With fuel prices remaining elevated and planned industry capacity growth set to accelerate in the fourth quarter from the third, analysts are watching whether carriers, including Delta, can raise fares further without discouraging travel.
Deutsche Bank analysts expect the industry to recover a smaller share of higher fuel costs through revenue measures in the fourth quarter, with full recovery not expected until early 2027.
Delta said demand remains strong. With almost 60% of the fourth quarter already booked, it expects revenue growth of about 20% from a year ago, Snell said.
"The general sentiment from our experts is that much of the revenue results and outlooks are held up by the premium passenger and higher fares," Third Bridge analyst Liam Dorsey said.
"At the moment, those higher prices have not destroyed any demand and it remains to be seen how long that will last."
REFINERY ADVANTAGE Delta has an advantage over other major US airlines: [USN:L4N4051W8 TEXT:"its ownership of a refinery"] outside Philadelphia that Snell expects to generate $700 million in profit this year.
"We have a refinery that gives us an offset, a partial offset to fuel prices that no one else does," Snell said.
Bought in 2012, the Monroe refinery processes crude oil into jet fuel and other products. Delta still pays market prices for fuel transferred to its airline operations, but retains the refining profit within the company.
That helps when the gap between crude and refined fuel prices widens, increasing costs for airlines buying from outside suppliers. The protection varies with refining margins, however, and the refinery can lose money when those margins weaken.
But the refinery can only partly cushion the impact of higher fuel prices. Even with a projected refinery benefit of 40 cents a gallon, Delta expects its fuel cost to rise to $4.25 a gallon in the fourth quarter from $3.61 in the third.
Snell said fuel costs were expected to stay elevated for some time.
"Ultimately, fuel will come down. When that is, we're not exactly sure," he said.

具体例として、日銀が大規模な金融緩和として実施していた長短金利操作（イールドカーブコントロール）を２０２４年に撤廃し、金融市場の機能が回復し始めた点に言及した。

items.title: Wall St climbs as oil slips; SpaceX spectrum deal weighs on telecoms
items.author: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: US stock indexes edged higher on Friday as oil prices retreated on easing Middle East supply concerns, though telecom shares remained under pressure after SpaceX's spectrum acquisition raised competitive concerns across the sector.
items.body:
US stock indexes edged higher on Friday as oil prices retreated on easing Middle East supply concerns, though telecom shares remained under pressure after SpaceX's spectrum acquisition raised competitive concerns across the sector.
Oil prices fell after US President Donald Trump said on Thursday the country [USN:L1N45U0PH TEXT:"will not attack"] Iran before US midterm elections next month, easing supply concerns.
Brent crude prices were down around 1%, but were still trading over the $100-a-barrel mark.
US Treasury yields were also calmer, with the benchmark 10-year yield steady at 5.25% but holding close to the 24-year high of 5.364% hit on Wednesday.
The benchmark S&P 500 (.SPX) and the tech-heavy Nasdaq were headed for weekly gains despite pulling back over the previous two sessions as optimism around an AI-driven third-quarter earnings season pushed both the indexes to record highs earlier this week.
The blue-chip Dow was also on track for slim weekly gains and the equal-weighted S&P 500 index (.SPXEW) was on track to snap a seven-week losing streak.
Megacap growth stocks were broadly higher, with Tesla (TSLA.O) rising 1.8%, Nvidia (NVDA.O) up 1.5%, and Microsoft (MSFT.O) up 1.2%.
Chip stocks were broadly higher a day after dropping sharply following [USN:L4N45U1QQ TEXT:"reports"] that OpenAI's annualized revenue was $20 billion below prior expectations.
Ten out of eleven sectors advanced, with real estate (.SPLRCR) and consumer discretionary (.SPLRCD) leading the gains, each rising by about 1%.
The S&P 500 communication services (.SPLRCL) was marginally lower after SpaceX (SPCX.O) gained 3.2% after the rocket and satellite maker struck a [USN:L6N45U1AK TEXT:"deal to acquire"] a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, posing a direct challenge to US wireless giants.
Telecom firms traded lower, with T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) down 9.1%, AT&T (T.N) falling 7.4% and Verizon (VZ.N) easing 6.3%.
At 9:42 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 136.24 points, or 0.27%, to 51,367.88, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 25.23 points, or 0.32%, to 7,790.59 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 130.99 points, or 0.48%, to 27,324.33.
The quarterly earnings season gathers pace next week with big banks on deck. Optimism around strong earnings continues to support US stocks despite geopolitical and rate concerns.
"The banks are great to figure out: are people borrowing, and what the situation looks like right now ... that is also going to give us data as to what the Fed may or may not do," said Kim Forrest, chief investment officer at Bokeh Capital Partners.
Among individual movers, Humana (HUM.N) jumped 16.6% after US government data showed 95% of the [USN:L4N45V0LU TEXT:"health insurer's"] members were in Medicare Advantage plans rated four stars or higher for 2027.
Apple (AAPL.O) fell 2.2% after a media report that the [USN:L6N45V0A6 TEXT:"iPhone maker"] has told some suppliers to cut production of components for its newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as soaring memory chip costs and price increases dampen consumer demand.
Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) dropped 3%, as the company cut its [USN:L1N45V0AC TEXT:"annual profit forecast"] by nearly a quarter at the midpoint of the range.
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.65-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.53-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
The S&P 500 posted 4 new 52-week highs and 3 new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 17 new highs and 75 new lows.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] - 中国財政省は９日、成長目標達成に向けて地方政府の財政を支え、インフラ投資を拡大するため、未使用の政府債務枠５５００億元（８２０億ドル）を割り当てた。

うち３０００億元は、県級政府の日常業務を支援するために充てられ、残りはインフラプロジェクト、特に建設中のプロジェクトや、経済的に力強い地域でのプロジェクトに充てられるという。

政策当局者は過去２年間も、年末の財政刺激策として未使用の政府債務枠を活用してきたが、今年は２０２４年と２５年の額を上回っている。

同省は別の声明で、より積極的な財政政策を「力強くかつ効果的に」実施し、内需の拡大を支援すると表明した。

うち３０００億元は、県級政府の日常業務を支援するために充てられ、残りはインフラプロジェクト、特に建設中のプロジェクトや、経済的に力強い地域でのプロジェクトに充てられるという。

政策当局者は過去２年間も、年末の財政刺激策として未使用の政府債務枠を活用してきたが、今年は２０２４年と２５年の額を上回っている。

同省は別の声明で、より積極的な財政政策を「力強くかつ効果的に」実施し、内需の拡大を支援すると表明した。

Oct 9 : Global money market funds drew strong inflows in the week ended October 7 as a global bond selloff, concerns over government debt levels in parts of Europe and lingering inflation fears pushed investors toward safer assets.
Investors bought global money market funds of a net $153.81 billion during the week, registering their largest weekly net purchase since May 6, LSEG Lipper data showed.
French bonds came under selling pressure last week, pushing the 10-year yield to a 24-year high of 4.994 per cent, amid concerns over the country's wide budget deficit exceeding 5 per cent of GDP and a potentially divisive presidential election next year.
The US 10-year Treasury yield also climbed to a 24-1/2-year high of 5.3645 per cent on Wednesday, as higher oil prices raised fears that inflation could prove more persistent than expected.

Investors, meanwhile, made net purchases of $560 million in global equity funds — the smallest weekly inflow in three weeks.
European equity funds attracted $6.19 billion, their largest weekly inflow in four weeks. Investors also added a net $6.16 billion to Asian equity funds, but withdrew $5.11 billion from U.S. funds.
Among sectoral funds, technology, utilities and industrials recorded notable inflows of $5.37 billion, $1.10 billion and $1.03 billion, respectively. Financial sector funds, however, saw weekly outflows of $3.47 billion.
Global bond funds drew $26.03 billion in the week, their largest weekly inflow since July 8.
Short-term bond funds gained $9.36 billion, marking their largest weekly inflow in three months. Government bond funds and loan participation funds also recorded notable inflows of $4.65 billion and $1.89 billion, respectively.
Among commodity funds, gold and other precious metals funds recorded a fourth consecutive week of net purchases, totalling $1.41 billion. Investors also bought $269 million worth of energy funds.
In emerging markets, bond funds attracted $1.48 billion in weekly inflows, broadly reversing the prior week's $1.86 billion in outflows. Equity funds, however, recorded a fifth consecutive weekly outflow of $752 million, according to data covering 27,895 funds.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ノーベル平和賞にピレイ元ＩＣＣ判事、ガザ「集団虐殺」報告主導
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Gwladys Fouche　Nora Buli

[オスロ ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Gwladys Fouche　Nora Buli

[オスロ ９日 ロイター] - ノルウェーのノーベル賞委員会は９日、ナビ・ピレイ元国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）判事にノーベル平和賞を授与すると発表した。ピレイ氏はイスラエルがパレスチナ自治区ガザでジェノサイド（集団虐殺）を行ったと結論付けた国連報告書の取りまとめを主導した。

委員会は授賞理由として「平和と国際法の促進に向けた努力」を挙げた。今年の平和賞は、国際社会の秩序を維持する重要性を示すものだと説明した。

「国際法の体系は大きな圧力にさらされ、その諸機関は攻撃を受けている」と指摘した。「法の枠組みや、法と正義を尊重する国際社会の姿勢が損なわれ、力の政治へと移行しつつある。力が正義に勝れば、必ず安定と信頼、平和的共存が脅かされる」と訴えた。

ピレイ氏（８５）は南アフリカ東部ナタール州ダーバンで、インド系タミル人の家庭に生まれた。ＩＣＣやルワンダ国際刑事裁判所など、複数の国際裁判所で判事を務めた。

また、イスラエルがガザでジェノサイドを行ったと２０２５年に結論付けた国連のパレスチナ自治区に関する調査委員会の委員長を務めた。イスラエルはこの報告書を「言語道断だ」と退けた。国連人権高等弁務官も務めた。

１９６７年にはナタール州で女性として初めて法律事務所を開設し、南アの高等裁判所で非白人女性として初めて判事を務めた。

＜揺るぎない倫理観＞

委員会はピレイ氏が国家や指導者の責任を追及し、暴力や紛争の被害者に希望をもたらしたほか、長年にわたる活動で揺るぎない倫理観を示したと評価した。

「アパルトヘイト（人種隔離政策）に立ち向かった（元南ア大統領）ネルソン・マンデラ氏らを弁護した初期の活動から、現代の重要な国際裁判で判事を務めたことまで、その姿勢は一貫している」と述べた。

ＩＣＣに対しては、トランプ米大統領が圧力を強めており、米国は赤根智子所長や複数の検察官と判事に制裁を科した。トランプ氏は９月、各国にＩＣＣからの脱退を呼びかけた。

オスロ国際平和研究所のホーコン・イェルロウ所長代行は、委員会がピレイ氏への平和賞授与でトランプ氏を直接批判したわけではないとの見方を示した。「むしろ国際法に基づく世界秩序を後押しするものだと思う。もちろん、ＩＣＣに関わった人物の受賞に（トランプ氏が）反応する可能性はあるが、トランプ氏への直接的な攻撃ではない」と述べた。

＜ニュルンベルクで受賞の知らせを聞く＞

ピレイ氏は、ドイツのニュルンベルクで法律関係の会議に出席中、受賞の知らせを受けた。会場の建物は、ナチスの犯罪を裁くため１９４５─４６年に初の国際軍事裁判所が設置された場所だった。

人権団体アムネスティ・インターナショナルの代表が交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿した動画によると、ピレイ氏は受賞を祝って集まった人々に「直近で手掛けたのは、ガザで起きていることをジェノサイドと認定した報告書の提出だ」と語った。

さらに「もう少し拍手してくれれば、この賞をトランプ氏と分け合うかもしれない」と述べ、笑いを誘った。昨年の平和賞受賞者マリア・コリナ・マチャド氏が、ベネズエラの民主化運動への支持を得るため、１月に自身のノーベル賞メダルをトランプ氏に贈った判断を念頭に置いた発言とみられる。

ノーベル賞委員会のヨルゲン・バトネ・フリードネス委員長 はロイターに対し、平和を確保するために築かれた国際体制が「大きな圧力」にさらされており、「最も強大な国々には特別な責任があるが残念ながら世界中でこうした状況が見られる。諸機関が攻撃を受けている。多くの判事が制裁を科されている」と語った。

ＩＣＣの赤根所長は、声明で受賞を歓迎し「国際法秩序と法の支配が深刻な課題に直面する中、今回の評価には特別な意義がある」と表明した。

平和賞の賞金は１２００万スウェーデンクローナ（約１２０万ドル）。授賞式は１２月１０日にオスロで開かれる予定だ。

items.title: Eleição pode remodelar comércio entre Brasil e EUA, com foco em tarifas e minerais críticos
items.author: Luciana Novaes Magalhaes, Brendan O'Boyle
items.creator: Luciana Novaes Magalhaes, Brendan O'Boyle
items.summary: Duas visões drasticamente diferentes para as relações entre o Brasil e os Estados Unidos estão em jogo no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais, mas tanto as estratégias do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) quanto as do atual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) apresentam seus próprios riscos, na avaliação de especialistas.
items.body:
Duas visões drasticamente diferentes para as relações entre o Brasil e os Estados Unidos estão em jogo no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais, mas tanto as estratégias do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) quanto as do atual presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) apresentam seus próprios riscos, na avaliação de especialistas.
Flávio avançou para o segundo turno, que será realizado em 25 de outubro, com impulso após garantir 47% dos votos no primeiro turno, contra 45% de Lula, em uma campanha marcada por críticas à relação de ambos os candidatos com Washington.
Quem vencer as eleições terá que lidar com as tensões entre os dois maiores parceiros comerciais do Brasil -- China e Estados Unidos -- ao mesmo tempo em que define estratégias para o desenvolvimento mineral, a industrialização e a cooperação regional.
Brasil e Estados Unidos criaram um grupo de trabalho no mês passado para conduzir as negociações sobre tarifas e uma estrutura comercial bilateral mais ampla, com o acesso dos EUA aos minerais críticos e terras raras do Brasil emergindo como um ponto-chave de discórdia, enquanto Washington busca reduzir sua dependência da China para esses minerais.
Caso o senador de oposição vença, "talvez os norte-americanos não queiram entregar nada para o Lula. Podem deixar tudo para o Bolsonaro", disse Rubens Barbosa, ex-embaixador brasileiro nos EUA.
A estratégia de Lula em relação aos EUA tem se concentrado na defesa da soberania do Brasil, após o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, pressionar o Judiciário brasileiro a retirar as acusações contra o pai de Flávio, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que cumpre pena de 27 anos por tentativa de golpe de Estado.
Um tom nacionalista tem norteado a atuação de Lula em relação a Washington, enquanto ele prioriza o multilateralismo e laços mais estreitos com o Sul Global, incluindo o bloco Brics de economias emergentes.
Embora essa abordagem tenha contribuído para sua popularidade, Lula tem tido um progresso irregular nas negociações com Washington, disseram especialistas à Reuters.
Caso Lula consiga se reeleger, o novo Congresso dominado por partidos de direita poderá pressionar um "Lula mais fraco" a mudar de tática, afirmou Monica de Bolle, pesquisadora sênior do Peterson Institute for International Economics, em Washington.
"Acredito que Lula sofreria muita pressão para ceder a algumas exigências dos EUA em relação aos recursos naturais, bem como a outras questões", disse De Bolle.
AS JOGADAS DE BOLSONARO Enquanto Lula tem uma "política internacional bem definida", a de Flávio é uma "página em branco", disse Rubens Ricupero, ex-diplomata brasileiro que atuou nos EUA e na Europa.
O senador mantém uma relação amistosa com o governo Trump, com a ajuda de seu irmão Eduardo Bolsonaro, ex-deputado federal que reside nos EUA desde o início do ano passado e foi condenado pelo Supremo Tribunal Federal por incitar a intervenção dos EUA nos processos judiciais de seu pai em 2025.
Embora nenhum dos irmãos tenha confirmado os rumores, uma pessoa próxima à campanha de Flávio disse à Reuters que os dois têm discutido possíveis funções internacionais para Eduardo, caso o senador se torne o próximo presidente do Brasil.
Se Flávio for eleito presidente, "haverá uma política externa muito mais alinhada com os Estados Unidos do que o Brasil tradicionalmente tem tido", disse De Bolle.
Os laços estreitos da família com o governo Trump podem garantir um ambiente de negociação mais favorável com Washington, embora Flávio corra o risco de fazer concessões em questões-chave, como minerais estratégicos, disseram especialistas.
"Acho que as portas estão abertas para bons acordos entre Brasil e EUA... mas Flávio será mais cobrado a manter um discurso de independência", disse Jean Castro, presidente da Associação Brasileira de Relações Institucionais e Governamentais (Abrig).
Desde o lançamento de sua campanha, Flávio tem cortejado Trump, assim como outros aliados de direita no exterior, como o argentino Javier Milei e o colombiano Abelardo de la Espriella.
Flávio e Trump já alinharam suas estratégias para combater o crime organizado. Em visita a Washington, em maio, o senador instou Trump a designar as principais facções criminosas brasileiras como Organizações Terroristas Estrangeiras, proposta aceita por Washington, mas rejeitada por Lula, que a considerou uma intervenção. Lula defende uma política nacional de combate ao crime organizado, com cooperação internacional.
Pesquisas de opinião pública mostram que a popularidade de Lula aumentou devido às suas frequentes divergências com Trump sobre comércio e segurança, e indicam que os brasileiros responsabilizam mais Flávio pelas tarifas impostas por Trump em julho.
"Ele não pode adotar uma postura que seja confundida com subserviência", disse Castro.

items.title: Canada's TSX gains after surprise job losses bolster rate-hold outlook
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Canada's blue-chip stock index rose on Friday in broad-based gains as investors assessed weaker-than-expected jobs data that reinforced bets that the Bank of Canada will keep interest rates on hold at its meeting later this month.
items.body:
Canada's blue-chip stock index rose on Friday in broad-based gains as investors assessed weaker-than-expected jobs data that reinforced bets that the Bank of Canada will keep interest rates on hold at its meeting later this month.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was up 0.92% at 35,462.14 points by 09:46 a.m. ET (1346 GMT).
Precious metal miner-linked materials sector (.GSPTTMT) rose 2.8%, leading sectorwise gains, as gold advanced more than 1% on a combination of cooling oil prices and a softer US dollar
Canada's economy [USN:L1N45V0EG TEXT:"stunned widespread expectations"] to post a massive job loss in September and the unemployment rate edged up, data showed
The economy lost a net of 68,300 jobs in September, while analysts polled by Reuters had forecast jobs gains of 9,200
Odds of an interest rate raise by the BoC at its next meeting dipped to 27% from 40% after the data, swap market data showed
Investors still price in a 25-basis-point rate hike at its December meeting, LSEG compiled data showed
The jobs report "is probably is going to tip the balance in favor of the Bank of Canada continuing to hold rates at their upcoming meetings rather than raising them," said Brian Madden, chief investment officer with First Avenue Investment Counsel
Aritzia (ATZ.TO) shares surged 16.7% after the apparel retailer topped analyst expectations for second-quarter revenue and profit, lifting the consumer discretionary sector (.GSPTTCD) 2.1% higher
Eight out of 10 major sectors were trading higher, while energy (.SPTTEN) gained 1.1%, despite softer oil prices, and heavily weighted financials (.SPTTFS) inched 0.3% higher
Despite the session's gains, the TSX remained on track for a third straight weekly decline as elevated bond yields and inflationary worries pressured risk appetite
items.raw_description: Canada's blue-chip stock index rose on Friday in broad-based gains as investors assessed weaker-than-expected jobs data that reinforced bets that the Bank of Canada will keep interest rates on hold at its meeting later this month.

items.title: Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種企業、第3四半期は31％増益へ　ＡＩ関連けん引
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Caroline Valetkevitch

[ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Caroline Valetkevitch

[ニューヨーク ９日 ロイター] - 米国企業は第３・四半期に再び大幅な増益を達成する見込みで、株式市場の上昇と同様、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業がけん引している。

ＬＳＥＧによると、アナリストは第３・四半期のＳ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の利益が前年同期比で平均約３１％増加すると予想しており、その増加分の３分の２はハイテクセクターとＡＩ大手アルファベット、アマゾン、メタ・プラットフォームズによるもの。来週にはＪＰモルガン・チェースやゴールドマン・サックスなど銀行の決算発表で第３・四半期決算シーズンが始まる。

ウェルズ・ファーゴ・インベストメント・インスティテュートのグローバル株式・実物資産担当責任者サミール・サマナ氏は「全てはＡＩによるもので、エネルギーと素材も多少影響しているが、それは地政学的な要因によるものだ。成長の７０─８０％がハイテクとＡＩによるものだとしても驚かない」と語る。

エネルギー部門の利益は前年比約１１５％増加すると見込まれている。米原油価格はイラン戦争が続いているため、第３・四半期に約３０％急騰した。

サマナ氏は、生活必需品部門と不動産部門を挙げ、これらが前年比増益率予測が最も低い部類に入ると指摘した。

アメリプライズ・フィナンシャルのチーフ市場ストラテジスト、アンソニー・サグリンベネ氏は「投資家にとって懸念されるのは収益成長がピークに近づいている点だ」と話す。

ＬＳＥＧのデータに基づくと、ＡＩブーム最大の受益分野の一つである米半導体企業の利益は、第２・四半期の約１５８％増に対し、第３・四半期は約１３６％増加したもよう。

独立系調査会社アーニングス・スカウトのニック・ライヒ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）氏は「業績予想修正の勢いは鈍化し始めている。ＡＩインフラの構築は今も時速１００マイルで進んでいるが、３カ月前は時速１５０マイルだった」と述べた。

投資家は、今回の決算発表シーズンにおいて、金利上昇が企業利益にどのような影響を与えるかにも目を配りそうだ。

前出のサマナ氏によると、公益部門のような多額の借り入れを行っている企業は危険にさらされている。

AI-centered US stock bull market nears four-year anniversary

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : The US bull market is going strong as it nears its four-year anniversary, driven by an AI spending engine that is propelling corporate profits and economic growth.
The S&P 500 is trading around record-high levels ahead of October 12, which will mark four years since the benchmark stock index's closing low for this cycle — signaling the start of the latest bull run.
Sizzling corporate profit growth — lifted by spending on the AI expansion and a solid economic backdrop — has helped drive the latest leg of the market's rally and is a primary reason for investor optimism in coming quarters.
But even as the index climbs, risks loom. The Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes and spiking US Treasury yields both provide obstacles that could sap the momentum for equities. Markets could be volatile heading into next month's US midterm elections.

The market's dependence on AI also presents a worry, with any hints of weakness in the trend possibly met with severe punishment.
"The AI theme is the defining feature of this bull market," said Anthony Saglimbene, chief market strategist at Ameriprise. "What you're seeing in terms of the bull market four years in is, I think, the easy money around AI has been made ... as we get further into this bull market, there is just going to be more pressure on especially technology companies to prove that the spending that they're doing today is actually going to translate into the profits."
CURRENT RUN RANKS MIDDLE-AGED AMONG BULLS
As bull markets go, the current one could be classified as middle-aged. The S&P 500's latest run ranks as the eighth-longest bull market since World War Two, according to Ryan Detrick, chief market strategist at Carson Group.
While stock experts differ on defining a bull market, a common definition is a gain of at least 20 per cent that has followed a decline of at least 20 per cent from a peak.
The current bull run has tallied a gain of 117 per cent, which is the sixth-best-performing bull market since World War Two.
"Four years is not, by any stretch of the imagination, scary with regards to a bull market," said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist for Nationwide. "They don't end of old age; they end from disease."
TECH, AI AT HEART OF BULL RUN
AI has dominated the latest bull run, with the launch of ChatGPT coming about a month after the bull market began. US companies are posting massive profit growth, with S&P 500 earnings expected to rise more than 35 per cent this year, boosted by capital spending from "hyperscalers" to build data centers.
Oxford Economics estimates about one-third of recent US economic growth stems from AI, including the net impact of direct investment to support expansion of AI infrastructure as well as some contribution from the wealth effect from stock market gains lifting consumer spending.
"You're seeing that AI theme show up in the economy and in corporate profits," Saglimbene said.
Of the 11 S&P 500 sectors, only technology and communication services — which includes megacap AI players Alphabet and Meta Platforms — have posted stronger gains than the index itself during the bull run.
The market capitalization of Nvidia — whose AI chips have made the company the poster child of this technological era — has soared to $5.8 trillion from $286 billion on October 12, 2022. It has become the largest company by market value in the world. Thirteen US companies boast market values of at least $1 trillion — all but two either in the tech sector or with significant AI exposure.
CONCENTRATION RISK GROWS WITH TECH DOMINANCE
The gains in massive tech and AI stocks give them more significant sway over major stock indexes, but also make them top-heavy. The weight of the top 10 companies in the S&P 500 has grown to about 40 per cent from about 28 per cent in October 2022, according to J.P. Morgan Asset Management.
"It is a reflection of fundamental strength and earnings outperformance, but also it introduces some risks," said Angelo Kourkafas, senior global investment strategist at Edward Jones. "The risk of concentration is that if the prevailing theme goes out of favor, portfolios might feel it in an outsized way."
Another risk is the Fed's recent pivot to rate hikes, as the US central bank seeks to bring down high inflation. Tighter monetary policy could slow the economy, perhaps severely. Indeed, the last bear market that led to the low in October 2022 coincided with a sharp rate-hiking cycle.
Rate hikes also factor in to the huge jump in Treasury yields. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield was hovering at around 5.2 per cent, after recently reaching its highest level in 24 years.
Higher yields pose headwinds for equities, including potentially greater investment competition from bonds.
Kourkafas said Edward Jones remains overweight equities but the recommendation is less aggressive than it was before, with the strategist noting the increasing attractiveness of fixed income.
"We still think that the bull market is not about to end ... but it makes sense to us to take some of the risk off the table," he said.

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 9 : US companies are likely to deliver another earnings surge for the third quarter, and like the rally in the stock market, AI-related players are fueling most of those gains.
While investors are enthusiastic about the hyper earnings growth fueled by AI companies, many are also worried about how long the trend can continue, and what will happen to share prices when it ends.
Analysts on average expect S&P 500 earnings to rise about 31 per cent year-over-year for the third quarter, with two-thirds of that leap coming from the technology sector and AI heavyweights Alphabet, Amazon.com and Meta Platforms, according to Tajinder Dhillon, LSEG's head of earnings and equity research.
Tech share gains helped the S&P 500 reach a record high this week ahead of the earnings season, which is expected to unofficially kick off next week with results from banks including JPMorgan Chase and Goldman Sachs.

"It's all AI and, to a lesser extent, energy and materials, but that's because of geopolitics," said Sameer Samana, head of global equities and real assets at Wells Fargo Investment Institute. "It wouldn't surprise me if 70-80 per cent of the growth can be attributed to tech and AI."
Energy earnings are seen up about 115 per cent from a year ago, with US oil prices having surged roughly 30 per cent in the third quarter because of the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran.
"Almost as telling is if you look at the sectors that are not related to AI at all," Samana said, pointing to consumer staples and real estate, whose year-over-year earnings growth estimates for the third quarter are among the weakest.
Still, strategists are not sure if third-quarter earnings growth can surpass the banner growth of the second quarter. The majority of companies tend to beat analysts' estimates, and that is likely to be the case again in the third-quarter season.
Year-over-year S&P 500 earnings grew in the second quarter by nearly 54 per cent, the highest since 2021, LSEG data showed. Excluding mark-to-market gains at Alphabet and Amazon.com on AI-related investments, that growth was about 35 per cent, still the highest since 2021.
"A concern for investors is we are kind of approaching peak earnings growth" for the current cycle, said Anthony Saglimbene, chief market strategist at Ameriprise Financial. "A lot of this AI trade is built on continued capex spending, and every quarter we go, and they continue to spend, the hurdle rates get higher and the scrutiny gets larger."
Earnings for US semiconductor companies, among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, are expected to have increased about 136 per cent in the third quarter compared with about 158 per cent in the second quarter, Dhillon said, based on LSEG data.
"Earnings estimate revision momentum is starting to cool," said Nick Raich, CEO of the Earnings Scout, an independent research firm.
"We're still going 100 miles an hour in the AI infrastructure buildout, but three months ago we were going 150 miles an hour."
Raich said the most recent reports including from Micron Technology have been strong and suggest other companies are still "reaping the benefits."
Chipmaker Micron last month forecast quarterly revenue above estimates and said customers had increased commitments under its long-term supply agreements to $32 billion.
This week Google entered a massive power deal with Constellation Energy.
Investors are also likely to pay close attention this earnings season to how higher interest rates may be affecting corporate profits.
US bond yields have risen because of concerns about inflation, higher oil prices and debt problems in France and elsewhere.
Heavy borrowers, such as utilities, are at risk, Samana said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米国民の78％、物価高の責任はトランプ政策　共和支持者4割不満
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir　Jason Lange

［ワシントン　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir　Jason Lange

［ワシントン　９日　ロイター］ - 米国民の７８％が、収入の伸びを上回る物価上昇の責任はトランプ米大統領の政策にあると考えていることが、ロイター／イプソスの最新の世論調査で明らかになった。共和党支持者の５７％が、物価の伸びが給与の伸びを上回っていると回答した。１１月の中間選挙を前に、共和、民主両党いずれの支持者も過半数が生活費を最大の懸念とした。

調査は５日まで実施し、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。誤差は米国民全体でプラスマイナス２ポイント、共和党支持者、民主党支持者、無党派層ではそれぞれ同３ポイント。

トランプ氏の経済運営を支持しない割合は、共和党支持者で約２５％、無党派層が６３％、民主党支持者は９２％だった。インフレ対応への評価はさらに厳しく、回答者全体の６８％、共和党支持者の４０％が不満を示した。

＜「何もかも値上がりした」＞

全米のガソリン平均価格は８日時点で１ガロン＝４．３６ドルで、１年前の３．１１ドルから上昇。軽油価格は記録的な上昇を経て６．２８ドルとなった。カンザス州などの農業州で、その影響が最も強く感じられている。

カンザス州カンザスシティーに住むヒスパニック系のアシーナ・バレットさん（４１）は、「ガソリン、食料品、生活費、何もかも値上がりした」と述べ、トランプ大統領の仕事ぶりに不満を示した。

ヒスパニック系有権者は２４年の大統領選で多くがトランプ氏を支持したが、世論調査では支持が低下している。

回答者は、投票先を決める上での重要課題として生活費を挙げた。過去１年間で生活費が「大幅に上昇した」と感じている人は５４％（共和党支持者では４０％）。「わずかに上昇した」は３０％、「変わらない」は１０％だった。

回答者の約７８％（共和党支持者の６４％、無党派層の７６％を含む）は、ホワイトハウスにも一定の責任があると答えた。米国民の大半は、関税を物価高の重要な要因と見なしている。

＜支出への影響は限定的＞

ただ今回の調査では、支出を切り詰めている兆候は限られていた。外食の頻度を減らしたと答えた割合は全体の約６３％、娯楽や動画配信サービスへの支出を減らしたと答えたのは５６％。車の運転を減らしている、あるいは支払いが滞っているとの回答は、これより少なかった。

経済指標を見ると、税金や物価上昇を考慮しても、米国民の所得は全体としてなお小幅に増えている。時間当たり賃金の伸びは全体として消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）とほぼ同じペースにとどまっている。

有権者はトランプ政権の政策の一部にはなお共感している。回答者の４５％が、不法移民を物価高の根本的な原因に挙げた。

items.title: 中国国慶節、国内旅行1回当たり支出4年ぶり低水準　海外旅行増
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sophie Yu　Julie Zhu

[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sophie Yu　Julie Zhu

[北京／香港 ９日 ロイター] - 今年の中国国慶節休暇期間中（１０月１─７日）の国内旅行１回当たりの平均支出額は前年比１．９％減の８９３．９２元（１３３．５１ドル）と、新型コロナウイルス流行に伴う規制で最も厳しかった時期に６８０．６０元にまで落ち込んだ２０２２年以来の低水準となった。堅調な旅行需要が個人消費の広範な回復を後押しするという期待は打ち砕かれた。

９日に公表された政府データに基づきロイターが算出した。

中国では近年、長期化する不動産市場の低迷、賃金上昇の鈍化、雇用市場の軟調さが家計心理を圧迫しており、個人消費は依然として低迷が続いている。

方徳証券のシニアアナリスト、エイルサ・リャオ氏は「われわれの見解では、主な制約要因は消費意欲の欠如ではなく、収入や雇用の見通しに対する不確実性にある」と述べた。

連休中は映画チケットの売上も落ち込んだ。

国慶節の連休は通常、春節（旧正月）と並んで中国で最も興行収入が見込まれる時期の一つ。しかし、中国の映画業界分析プラットフォーム「猫眼」のデータによると、今年の興行収入は前年比３６．６％減の１１億６０００万元にとどまり、１４年以来の低水準となった。

その代わりに、中国の消費者は海外旅行を選ぶようになった。

今回の連休は昨年より１日短かったものの、多くの旅行者がこれを９月２５日から２７日にかけての中秋節の連休と組み合わせ、最大１３日間の休暇を確保。旅行予約サイト、トリップ・ドット・コム・グループによると、同サイトを通じて予約された海外行きの航空券の半数以上が１０月１日より前の出発便で、平均旅行日数は９日間を超えた。

また、７泊以上の海外ホテル宿泊の予約は前年比１２３％増となり、複数の目的地を巡る旅程の予約も８４％増加したという。

items.title: AI in Banking: Risk and Reward | Bloomberg Tech: Europe 10/9/2026
items.summary:
This episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe, from the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin, examines how artificial intelligence is moving deeper into banking. Tom Mackenzie explores how banks are using AI to become faster and more efficient, and the new vulnerabilities that could emerge as the technology takes on more consequential decisions. Guests include JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky, Evident CEO Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Bending Spoons CEO Luca Ferrari.

"Bloomberg Tech: Europe" spotlights the biggest names and trends shaping the region's technology ecosystem as the global competition heats up. This monthly, 30-minute magazine-style show features in-depth interviews with top technology leaders, as well as major investors and policymakers - giving you a compelling A to Z of the most consequential innovations, opportunities and challenges. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 諮問会議の民間議員、骨太目標で提言　「未達の兆しなら成長戦略など見直しを」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　９日　ロイター］ - 政府が９日に開いた経済財政諮問会議で、民間議員らが「骨太の方針（経済財政運営と改革の基本方針）」に盛り込まれた中長期の経済財政計画について、目標達成が危ぶまれる場合には成長戦略や歳出・歳入など政策の枠組みを見直すよう提言した。

高市政権が７月に決定した骨太の方針は、中長期的な経済財政政策の目標として、実質１％超、名目３％超の経済成長率のほか、２０４０年度に国内投資２５０兆円、ＧＤＰ１１００兆円を実現することや、債務残高対ＧＤＰ比の安定的な引き下げを掲げている。

これらの目標について、「目標の実現が困難となるおそれを示す重要な兆し」が見られた場合には、「必要に応じて成長戦略の再構築、歳出・歳入の見直し等につなげる運営の仕組みを構築すべき」とした。

また、リーマン危機や新型コロナウイルスの世界的流行のような経済ショックが発生した場合には、債務残高対ＧＤＰ比が一時的に悪化しても歳出を急激に抑制しないよう、「柔軟性を確保する仕組み」も必要だと指摘した。

items.title: Trump Stock Market Is Driven by AI, Not Broad Economic Strength
items.author: Jonathan Levin
items.creator: Jonathan Levin
items.summary: President Donald Trump has long viewed the stock market as a referendum on his performance. Although the S&P 500 Index closed at an all-time high this week, it did so on the strength of a handful of companies focused on the booming artificial intelligence sector, papering over signs of growing vulnerabilities in the economy and financial markets. With the midterm elections less than a month away, what Trump sees as an asset for Republicans may in fact be a liability.

items.title: 米政権の永住権手続き凍結、インドＩＴ企業への影響は限定的か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kashish Tandon　Bharath Rajeswaran

[９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kashish Tandon　Bharath Rajeswaran

[９日 ロイター] - 高度な技能を持つ外国人労働者の永住権申請手続きの一部を米トランプ政権が凍結したことについて、アナリストらは９日、インドのＩＴ企業が短期的に打撃を受ける可能性は低いとの見方を示した。大手ＩＴ企業はこの制度への依存を減らしているためだ。

米国が停止対象としたのは、「永久労働認定制度（ＰＥＲＭ）」。米国内の外国生まれの人を減らし、永住権や市民権の取得を制限する幅広い取り組みの一環だ。

今回の措置は米マイクロソフト、コグニザント、印インフォシス、タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズ（ＴＣＳ）、ウィプロ、ＨＣＬテクノロジーズ、仏キャップジェミニを対象としている。

インド外務省は９日、今回の措置は両国が共有する目標の実現につながらないと批判した。「この件に関する米副大統領の発言も承知している。こうした表現は不当であり、米国で働くインド人専門職が高い教育と技能を備え、米国の経済やイノベーションを支える仕組みに貢献している事実を無視している」と指摘した。

バンス米副大統領は具体的な根拠を示さないまま、企業がＰＥＲＭ制度を利用して米国人従業員を外国人労働者に置き換え、賃金を押し下げていると主張していた。

ＩＣＩＣＩ証券は、今回の動きはインドＩＴ株にとって短中期的にマイナスだと分析した。主な理由として「目先の売上高への影響ではなく」、投資家心理の悪化と長期的な人材確保への懸念を挙げた。

同証券によると、２０２４年１０月─２５年９月に提出されたＰＥＲＭ申請のうち、インドのＩＴ企業が占めた割合は２％未満にとどまった。永住権取得を巡る不透明感が長引けば、米国で働く従業員の離職が増える可能性があると指摘した。

インドのＩＴ業界団体ＮＡＳＳＣＯＭは８日夜、ＩＴ企業が近年、米国での現地採用を拡大する一方、Ｈ－１Ｂビザへの依存を大幅に減らしてきたと説明した。Ｈ－１Ｂビザで働く人のうち、ＰＥＲＭの労働認定を経て永住権を取得する人は比較的少ないという。

インド最大のＩＴサービス輸出企業タタ・コンサルタンシー・サービシズは、過去２年間のＰＥＲＭ申請が１桁にとどまっていることを理由に、今回の停止が人員戦略や顧客との取引に影響するとは見込んでいないと述べた。

items.title: French student protesters vow to keep up their fight after scoring first win
items.author: Makini Brice, Dominique Vidalon
items.creator: Makini Brice, Dominique Vidalon
items.summary: The protests have snowballed into a wider movement, with more university students weighing in to express their anger over what they call a dysfunctional system.
items.body:
French student unions vowed on Friday to keep up protests after scoring what they called their first win in a campaign that is increasingly supported by Paris' elite universities, with 141 schools still shut around the country.
The protests have snowballed into a wider movement, with more university students weighing in to express their anger over what they call a dysfunctional system, worsened by spending cuts spurred by France's budget crunch.
Student and teacher unions have called for another round of nationwide school strikes next Tuesday.
France's education ministry is in the process of urgently contacting around 3,000 spare teachers who could be sent to schools with the most pressing needs, often located in low-income areas, Education Minister Edouard Geffray said.
Speaking during a visit to a school in the Paris region that was vandalised during protests, he said more than 100 teaching staff had been injured so far in the nationwide protests.
The movement has fueled similar student protests in Belgium, which on Friday were amplified by a national strike during which scuffles broke out between protesters and police in Brussels.
ELITE UNIVERSITIES ARE WEIGHING IN Police cleared a blockade at Assas university, a top French law school in central Paris, on Friday morning. Nearby, elite engineering school Mines Paris was also disrupted by blockades.
The Institut Catholique, a private university known for being particularly conservative, said on its website it would switch to remote classes due to a blockade of its campus.
Student unions meanwhile hailed what they see as their first real win, after the government late on Thursday pledged to send some 3,000 teachers, who are fully qualified but have not yet started work, to fill staffing gaps, one of the protesters' main grievances.
The move, which the government called an "emergency plan", shows it is worthwhile for students to continue their protests, Marius Mesnil, from a high school student union, told Franceinfo radio.
"I find it crazy we need to block hundreds of high schools just to get a vacancy plan," he added.
The measure is effective immediately and will cost "several dozen million euros", Geffray told broadcaster TF1 late on Thursday.
MARKETS MONITORING GOVERNMENT RESPONSE TO PROTESTS Three weeks into the protest, President Emmanuel Macron's government is struggling to work out how to balance demands for more education spending with the need to rein in public debt.
Investors are closely watching the government's next moves in a highly indebted country where street anger has often been tamed with more state spending. This time, France's large pension outlays and its need to rein in public spending leave little room for manoeuvre.
Stephane Boujnah, the head of Euronext, which runs the Paris stock market, said Paris urgently needed to make tough choices.
"What sacrifice are we asking of our own children? ... maybe we need to spend a little less on pensions so that we have a little more money for the children," he told RMC radio.
Nearly 10% of teaching hours are unstaffed at French state high schools, according to education ministry figures, prompting a growing number of wealthier parents to abandon the public sector in [USN:L1N45U0DV TEXT:"favour of private schooling"], a trend that some experts say will only reinforce social inequality.
"Let's be frank, families are leaving public schools for our institutions," said Pierre-Vincent Gueret, who heads France's federation of Catholic private schools.
The interior ministry said [USN:L1N45U08J TEXT:"71,500 people"] took to the streets in Paris and elsewhere on Thursday. While most protests were peaceful, violence flared up in some places.
In Belgium, meanwhile, students joined demonstrations alongside striking workers as the country's two largest labour unions staged a national strike on Friday, disrupting public transport, air travel and other sectors.
Thousands of people marched through central Brussels in a protest that was largely peaceful, although some scuffles broke out with police, who used tear gas and water cannons in some instances.
One banner carried by student protesters read: "I skipped class to defend class."
items.raw_description: The protests have snowballed into a wider movement, with more university students weighing in to express their anger over what they call a dysfunctional system.

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝上昇、午後にはセンチメント改善
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海 ９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海 ９日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は主要指数が小幅高。午後には前場の下げから戻したが１年ぶりの安値付近で引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のサプライチェーン銘柄が売られた。香港株はインターネット企業の値上がりを背景に上昇した。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．２％高、上海総合指数は０．１％高で終了。香港のハンセン指数は１．８％上昇した。

週間では、ＣＳＩ３００指数は１％近く下落し、９週連続の下げとなった。ハンセン指数は１％高だった。

５Ｇ通信指数は一時６％下落し、２カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。ハイテク関連中心の上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は一時４％下落し、５カ月ぶりの安値を付けた後、ほぼ横ばいで取引を終えた。

午後の取引ではセンチメントが改善し、ファーテン・ベリエンウォルド（華泰柏瑞）ＣＳＩ３００ＥＴＦなど、一部の主要大型株・小型株ＥＴＦの売買高が約２カ月ぶりの高水準に達した。

ＡＩデータセンター向け光トランシーバーの大手メーカー、中際旭創は１％安。メモリー半導体大手、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は１％高で引けた。

石炭指数は１．４％高、生活必需品株指数は０．８％高となり、投資家はリスク抑制のためディフェンシブ銘柄や伝統的セクターへと乗り換えた。

香港市場のハイテク大手株は反発し、３．１％上昇した。ただ、指数は２年ぶりの安値付近で推移している。

中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は８日、為替政策に対する海外からの批判に反論し、競争的な通貨切り下げを行ったことはないと表明した。欧州の政策当局者は、中国の記録的な貿易黒字と輸出急増を抑制するために人民元の上昇を求めている。
